title: Part-Time Social Media, Community & Content Assistant
job_title: Part-Time Social Media, Community & Content Assistant
description: Part-Time Social Media, Community & Content Assistant Remote | Philippines-based preferred | Fragrance Brand / Cat Social Media About the Brand Soki London is an independent British perfume brand founded by fragrance creator and YouTuber Sophie King. We create long-lasting, feminine, story-led fragrances inspired by powerful female characters, travel, romance and modern femininity. The brand has an active social media community across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with regular comments, customer engagement and a growing audience. We are looking for a reliable, creative and detail-oriented Social Media, Community & Content Assistant to help manage comments, create and post engaging short-form content, support content engagement, and assist with YouTube thumbnail and title testing. This is a part-time remote role, ideal for someone based in the Philippines with strong written English, good attention to detail, and experience supporting beauty, fashion, lifestyle, ecommerce or creator-led brands. Role Overview You will help keep the Soki London community engaged by replying to comments, identifying content opportunities, creating and posting short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, and supporting basic YouTube optimisation tasks. The role includes both community management and content support. You will be given brand guidelines, approved reply templates, product information, FAQs, content examples, raw footage, product imagery, brand assets and examples of Sophie’s tone of voice. You should be warm, careful, organised, proactive and creative, with a good understanding of TikTok and Instagram trends. Key Responsibilities 1. Instagram Comment Management You will help manage comments on Soki London & SokiCats Instagram posts, reels and ads. Replying to customer comments using approved brand tone and templates. Liking positive comments. Thanking customers for compliments and feedback. Answering simple product questions, such as where to buy the perfumes, sample availability, fragrance notes, travel spray size, vegan and cruelty-free status, £5 sample voucher information and stock availability. Flagging comments that need Sophie’s personal reply. Flagging complaints, order issues, allergy/ingredient questions, press enquiries, influencer requests or retailer enquiries. Saving strong customer comments or testimonials for future marketing use. Tracking repeated questions that could become future content ideas. 2. TikTok Comment Management You will help monitor and reply to TikTok comments on Soki London & SokiCats videos. Replying to comments in a friendly, conversational tone. Encouraging customers to try samples where relevant. Answering simple product or scent questions. Flagging comments that may be suitable for “reply with video” content. Identifying comments that show strong purchase intent. Noting recurring questions, objections or product requests. Liking positive comments. Escalating negative comments, complaints or sensitive questions. 3. Viral TikTok & Instagram Content Creation You will help create short-form video content for TikTok and Instagram Reels using existing Soki London & SokiCats assets, product imagery, raw footage, founder content, customer comments, trends and approved brand messaging. Creating TikTok videos and Instagram Reels using provided photos, videos, product clips and brand assets. Editing short-form videos in CapCut, Canva, TikTok editor, Instagram editor or similar tools. Turning customer comments into content ideas. Creating “reply to comment” style video concepts. Repurposing YouTube clips into TikTok and Instagram Reels. Identifying trending TikTok and Instagram sounds that are suitable for a beauty/fragrance brand. Creating simple, engaging hooks for videos. Adding captions, subtitles and on-screen text. Creating videos around product benefits, including long-lasting perfumes, £5 samples with £5 voucher, best perfumes for summer, bridal perfumes, compliment-getting scents, perfume layering, travel sprays, founder-led behind-the-scenes content, fragrance personality quizzes, customer reviews and testimonials. Suggesting content ideas based on current social trends. Creating simple “viral-style” videos that feel native to TikTok and Instagram rather than overly polished adverts. Testing different hooks, formats, captions and calls to action. Tracking which content performs best and suggesting more of what is working. 4. TikTok & Instagram Posting You will schedule and post approved content to TikTok and Instagram. Uploading approved videos to TikTok and Instagram Reels. Writing captions in the Soki London tone of voice. Adding relevant hashtags. Adding product tags or links where instructed. Selecting suitable cover images. Checking that captions, tags and links are correct before posting. Posting at agreed times. Monitoring early engagement after posting. Reporting which posts perform best. Keeping a content tracker updated with post date, caption, platform, link, views, likes, comments, saves and shares. Ensuring all content is approved before posting until trust and brand understanding are fully established. 5. YouTube Comment Management You will help manage comments on Sophie’s YouTube videos, including perfume review content and Soki London brand content. Replying to recent YouTube comments using approved guidelines. Liking or hearting positive comments where appropriate. Flagging thoughtful comments that may need Sophie’s personal response. Answering simple Soki London product questions. Directing viewers to samples or the website where appropriate. Identifying frequently asked questions. Highlighting potential video ideas based on viewer comments. Keeping track of common fragrance topics viewers are asking about. Escalating anything sensitive, negative, controversial or requiring personal input. 6. YouTube Thumbnail & Title A/B Testing Support You will assist with basic YouTube optimisation by helping test and track video titles and thumbnails. Uploading or setting up alternate thumbnails when instructed. Recording thumbnail/title tests in a tracking sheet. Monitoring performance before and after changes. Tracking metrics such as click-through rate, views, watch time, average view duration and impressions. Helping compare which title or thumbnail performs better. Suggesting title variations based on existing video themes and keywords. Suggesting thumbnail text options. Checking competitor or similar perfume videos for title inspiration. Reporting results clearly each week. You do not need to be a YouTube expert, but you should be comfortable using YouTube Studio and tracking results carefully. 7. Weekly Reporting Each week, you will provide a short report covering: Number of Instagram comments replied to. Number of TikTok comments replied to. Number of YouTube comments replied to. TikTok and Instagram content created. TikTok and Instagram content posted. Best-performing posts. Worst-performing posts. Trends or sounds worth using. Most common customer questions. Any complaints or issues to review. Any influencer, press or retail enquiries. Best customer comments/testimonials. Suggested content ideas from comments. Thumbnail/title tests currently running. Thumbnail/title test results. What You Should Escalate Please do not reply independently to: Customer complaints. Missing orders, shipping problems or refund requests. Ingredient safety questions. Allergy or medical questions. Legal, regulatory or compliance questions. Retailer or distributor enquiries. Press enquiries. Influencer collaboration requests. Negative comments that could become sensitive. Anything involving Sophie personally. Anything you are unsure about. Instead, flag these clearly for review. Ideal Candidate The ideal person will have: Excellent written English. Experience replying to social media comments for a brand, creator or ecommerce business. Experience creating TikTok videos and Instagram Reels. Good understanding of TikTok and Instagram trends. Ability to edit simple short-form videos. Experience with CapCut, Canva (We can provide access), TikTok editor, Instagram editor or similar. A warm, friendly and natural writing style. Good attention to detail. An understanding of beauty, fragrance, fashion or lifestyle brands. Ability to follow brand tone of voice. Ability to work independently and ask questions when unsure. Experience with Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Basic experience with YouTube Studio is a bonus. Experience with Shopify or ecommerce customer questions is a bonus. Reliable internet connection. Good organisation and communication skills. Brand Tone of Voice Soki London’s tone is: Warm. Feminine. Helpful. Founder-led. Elegant but not overly formal. Excited but not pushy. Friendly and conversational. Confident but never arrogant. The tone should feel like a helpful beauty founder or trusted fragrance friend. Avoid language that feels robotic, overly corporate, spammy, generic or too sales-focused. Example Comment Replies Comment: “Which one is best for summer?” Reply/Action: “Aphrodite is our most tropical summer scent — it has mango, lotus flower, palm leaves and coconut milk, so it feels really fresh and sun-kissed.” Comment: “Do you do samples?” Reply/Action: “Yes, we do £5 samples, and each one comes with a £5 digital voucher you can use towards any future purchase.” Comment: “Is this vegan?” Reply/Action: “Yes, Soki London fragrances are vegan and cruelty-free.” Comment: “I don’t know which one to choose.” Reply/Action: “Aphrodite is tropical and joyful, Cleopatra is sensual and bridal, Empress is fruity and gourmand, Artemis is woody and elegant, and Ophelia is fresh, clean and floral.” Comment: “My order hasn’t arrived.” Reply/Action: Action: Do not reply with a full answer. Flag to Sophie/customer service. Example Content Ideas The person in this role may help create content such as: “POV: you finally find a perfume that actually lasts.” “Which Soki London perfume are you?” “Perfumes for the girl who wants to smell expensive.” “The bridal perfume I created for my own wedding.” “A £5 perfume sample that gives you a £5 voucher.” “If you like tropical perfumes, try Aphrodite.” “If you want a clean girl floral, try Ophelia.” “Perfumes that feel like main character energy.” “Customer comments that made our day.” “Pack an order with me.” “Behind the scenes of an independent perfume brand.” “Three perfumes for three different moods.” “Perfume layering ideas with Soki London travel sprays.” Hours & Availability This is a part-time remote role. Expected hours: 10–15 hours per week to start, with the opportunity to increase if the role goes well. Preferred availability: Check comments at least once per working day. Create and/or schedule several short-form videos per week. Provide a short weekly report. Be available for occasional updates or instructions via email , Slack, WhatsApp, Trello or Asana. Trial Task As part of the application process, please complete the following tasks: Comment Reply Task Please reply to the following sample comments in the Soki London tone of voice: “Which perfume lasts the longest?” “Do you have samples?” “Is Cleopatra good for a wedding?” “Where can I buy this?” “I love the bottle, it’s so pretty!” “What does Ophelia smell like?” “Is this cruelty free?” “I’m not sure whether to get Aphrodite or Empress.” “Can influencers work with you?” “My order hasn’t arrived yet.” Content Idea Task Please suggest: 5 TikTok/Reel ideas for Soki London. 3 opening hooks for a video about long-lasting perfume. 3 opening hooks for a video about £5 samples. 3 caption ideas for a TikTok about Cleopatra as a bridal perfume. 3 trending-style video formats you think would work for a perfume brand. How to Apply Please apply with: A short introduction. Your relevant experience. Examples of brands, creators or social media accounts you have supported. Examples of TikToks, Reels or short-form videos you have created. Your hourly rate. Your availability per week. The tools you use for editing content. Your answers to the trial task above. Experience with beauty, fragrance, fashion, lifestyle, ecommerce or YouTube creators is preferred.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description: ## Job Title: Digital Marketing Manager (Philippines-Based) ### About Us [Unicorn Buyers Agents (UBA)]( ---------- ) is Sydney’s premier boutique buyers agency for owner-occupiers and investors. Led by our Director, Dan Sofo, we help families, first-time buyers, and expats navigate one of the toughest, most competitive property markets in the world. We don't just find houses; we secure dreams. To date, we have bought over 200+ properties worth more than $460M+, with 72% of our deals secured completely off-market or pre-auction. Based in beautiful Paddington, Sydney, we hold a flawless reputation backed by 99+ five-star Google reviews. We are elite at what we do—now, we want our digital footprint to match. ### The Vision: Own Our Marketing, Shape Our Future We are not looking for a Virtual Assistant to check off a daily to-do list. We are looking for an independent, strategic partner who will become an integral part of our core team. Right now, Dan is driving the ideas. **The goal of this role is to change that.** We want a high performer who will take the raw clay of our brand, our data, and Dan's insights, and use them to shape the future of how UBA performs online. You will start by executing our current framework, but your ultimate mandate is to outgrow it—introducing new channels (like Substack), mastering emerging tech (like AEO), and independently driving our entire marketing roadmap without needing to be told what to do. If you want a job where you are a valued builder, not just a cog in a machine, this is your canvas. --- ### Position Details & Career Progression Roadmap We want to invest heavily in the right person. This position is structured to scale alongside your performance and commitment to the brand. * **Year 1 Commitment (Part-Time):** * **Hours:** 30 hours per week (6 hours/day), Monday to Friday * **Shift:** 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM Philippine Time (PHST) — aligning perfectly with high-stakes Sydney business hours. * **Remuneration:** $1,000 AUD per month * **Year 2 & Beyond (Guaranteed Career Progression):** * **Guaranteed Pay Increase:** Upon reaching your 1-year tenure milestone, you will receive a **guaranteed 10% pay increase**. * **Full-Time Upgrade:** At the 1-year mark, this role will **upgrade to a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position**, allowing you to fully step into your role as our dedicated Marketing Driver. * **Location:** Remote (Philippines) --- ### Key Responsibilities & Future Growth Levers **1. Content Production & Social Media (Western Channels)** * Take Dan’s raw video footage from property inspections, market updates, and media appearances, and edit it into sharp, premium content. * Produce **3–4 long-form videos (1–3 minutes)** per week for YouTube and LinkedIn, and strategically repurpose them into highly engaging **short-form clips (30–60 seconds)**. * Manage, post, and optimize content across **Meta (Facebook /Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube**. **2. Copywriting & Email Marketing (Moving to Substack)** * Take our deep property insights and update the UBA website with regular, SEO-friendly blog posts. * Repurpose those insights into high-signal, engaging articles on **LinkedIn** to capture corporate professionals. * Manage and deploy our client and investor newsletters using **MailerLite**—with the immediate strategic goal of helping us launch, build, and monetize a premium presence on **Substack**. **3. Chinese Social Media Management (WeChat & Redbook)** * A massive growth lever for UBA is the Chinese-Australian and expat buyer market. You will take the lead on launching, managing, and growing our brand accounts on **WeChat Business** and **Xiaohongshu (Red/Redbook)** from scratch. **4. Performance Marketing & Future-Proofing (Google & AEO)** * Create, split-test, and optimize **Google Paid Ads** to continuously funnel high-quality discovery calls to Dan’s calendar. * **Drive our AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) efforts:** The future of search is changing. You will optimize our written and video content so that UBA is the definitive answer served by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google Gemini when affluent buyers search for Sydney property advice. --- ### Why a High Performer Should Join Us (What's In It For You) * **A Transparent Future:** We map out your growth from day one. Prove your value in year one, and unlock guaranteed higher pay and full-time security in year two. * **True Autonomy:** We don’t track every click; we track results, creativity, and initiative. You will have the freedom to test new ideas, fail fast, and build something you are proud of. * **Work Directly with a Thought Leader:** You will report directly to Dan Sofo. Dan is a hands-on, highly energetic Director who understands the value of elite marketing and will give you the resources and trust you need to succeed. * **An Unlimited Creative Sandbox:** Real estate is inherently visual and emotional. You'll be working with high-end Sydney property data, luxury property walkthroughs, and incredible client success stories. The "raw material" you get to work with is elite. --- ### Requirements & Qualifications * **Extreme Initiative:** If you are the type of person who waits for instructions, please do not apply. We want a self-starter who looks at our current marketing, identifies the gaps, and says, *"Hey Dan, I noticed we aren't optimizing for X, so I created a draft strategy for it."* * **Exceptional English & Aussie Nuance:** Our clients are buying multimillion-dollar properties. You must have flawless written and spoken English, and crucially, understand Australian cultural nuances, real estate terminology (auctions, off-market, passing-in), and tone. * **Elite Creativity:** You know how to edit videos so people actually watch past the first 3 seconds. You have an eye for sleek typography, clean transitions, and pacing. * **Technical & Forward-Thinking Stack:** Experienced in premium video editing tools, MailerLite (and ideally Substack), Google Ads Manager, Western/Chinese social media dashboards, and an understanding of modern AI search behavior (AEO/SEO). * **Reliability:** Strict availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM PHST. Must have a rock-solid internet connection and a reliable backup power solution. --- ### How to Apply We move fast. If you have the drive to turn Unicorn Buyers Agents into a digital content powerhouse and shape the future of our brand, please submit: 1. **Your updated resume.** 2. **A video introduction (1–2 minutes):** Tell Dan who you are and why you are the independent, strategic marketer he is looking for. 3. **Examples of your long-form writing work:** Since you will be taking over our website blogs, LinkedIn articles, and launching our Substack, please provide examples of long-form written content (e.g., articles, newsletters, or comprehensive blog posts) that demonstrate your ability to articulate complex ideas with a sharp, professional, and engaging tone. 4. **A link to your video editing portfolio/previous social media work.**

You will work on landmark-scale projects alongside experienced engineers and coordinators, in a team culture built on respect and collaboration. For a skilled Revit modeler ready to work at the standard that tier-one Australian construction demands, this is the kind of role that builds a career. Compensation and Benefits: PHP 45,000–60,000 per month Fully remote setup Paid Time Off + Prepaid HMO coverage Performance bonus Weekends off, dayshift hours Ready to Apply? Have you worked on prefabricated or modular construction projects? How familiar are you with Australian construction industry terminology and standards? Have you previously supported an Australian client or worked on projects following Australian specifications? Which of the following tools have you used professionally, and at what level of proficiency — Revit, Tekla Structures, Autodesk Inventor, and Bluebeam Revu? title: Outbound Sales Caller: eCommerce Abandoned Cart Recovery
job_title: Outbound Sales Caller: eCommerce Abandoned Cart Recovery
description: Before you apply, please read this whole post. I'm looking for one specific type of person, and the application instructions at the bottom are designed to filter out everyone who isn't. If you follow them, you'll stand out immediately. I run a fast growing ecommerce store. Every day, dozens of customers add products to their cart and then leave without buying. Your job is to call those people, win them back, and close the sale over the phone. You get a monthly base plus a cash bonus for every cart you recover. The better you are, the more you earn, with no cap. This is phone work. If you love being on the phone and you're motivated by hitting targets, keep reading. If you'd rather do quiet admin or data entry, this is not the role for you. What you'll actually be doing: 1.Calling customers who abandoned their cart, usually within minutes to hours of them leaving the site 2. Reopening the conversation, handling objections (price, hesitation, "just looking", "I'll do it later"), and getting them to complete the purchase 3. Following up by call, SMS or email where needed 4. Logging every call outcome accurately so we can track what's working 5. Hitting daily call volume and weekly recovery targets What success looks like: You'll be measured on three things- 1. Dials and contacts per day (your activity) 2. Contact-to-recovery conversion rate (your skill) 3. Total carts recovered per week (the outcome that earns your bonus) I'll give you clear targets in week one and review your numbers with you weekly. Strong performers get more hours, more responsibility, and a bigger bonus structure over time. Must-haves (please don't apply without these): 1. Proven outbound phone experience: telesales, appointment setting, cold calling, collections, or BPO outbound campaigns. Tell me exactly what you did. 2. Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, confident phone voice 3. Genuine comfort and enjoyment on the phone, plus thick skin for rejection 4. Availability during Australian hours, roughly 10am to 8pm AEST (about 8am to 6pm Philippine time), since our customers are in Australia 5. Reliable high speed internet, a good quality headset, and a quiet place to call from 6. Reliability and honest reporting. I track outcomes, so there is nowhere to hide a slow day, and I reward consistency. Nice-to-haves (not necessary but will help you stand out): 1. Experience with WooCommerce, which is the platform we use day to day 2. Experience in DTC ecommerce or with consumer products 3. Experience selling to Australian or other Western customers 4. Familiarity with diallers, SMS tools, or CRMs in general 5. Experience working to a commission or bonus structure before About the product (so you can self-select): We sell nicotine products to adult customers in Australia. You must be comfortable calling on behalf of an adult nicotine product. If that's a problem for you, this isn't the right fit, and that's completely fine. Pay: 1. Starting rate: USD $6 per hour, paid for every hour you work from day one. This is your guaranteed base and it does not go away. 2. The first two weeks are a paid probation on this flat hourly rate while we assess how you perform. 3. After you pass probation, you keep the hourly base and move onto a performance bonus for every cart you recover. This is where the real money is. The earning potential is high and completely uncapped: the more carts you recover, the more you make, on top of your hourly rate. 4. To be clear, this is a real job with a guaranteed wage, not commission-only work. But if you're a strong closer, the bonus will quickly become the biggest part of your pay. 5. We pay on time, every time. Hours: We expect a minimum commitment of 38 hours per week during the Australian calling window above. However, since this is a bonus-driven job, you may choose to work more hours to increase your earnings. How to apply: I will only read applications that do all three of these - 1. Start your message with the word RINGER. This tells me you read the entire post. Applications without it get deleted unread. 2. Attach a voice recording, maximum 60 seconds. Pretend you're calling a customer who left a few tins of nicotine pouches in their cart and didn't check out. Win them back. I want to hear your real phone voice, your tone, and how you'd open the call. Don't overthink it, just record it. Feel free to make up any commercial points such as fast shipping, best prices etc. If you are unaware of nicotine pouches, please look up ZYN and VELO prior to making your recording. These are the 2 key brands that we retail. 3. Answer these three questions briefly: 1. How many months or years of outbound phone experience do you have, and what kind of campaigns (AU/US sales, appointment setting, collections, and so on)? 2. What dialler or CRM tools have you used? 3. What were you measured on in your last phone role, and what numbers did you actually hit? That's it. If you're a genuine phone closer who reads instructions and follows them, you'll be miles ahead of most applicants. I'm ready to hire quickly for the right person.

title: Video Editor
description: Company Overview: At ACTIV, we are a forward-thinking ecommerce marketing agency dedicated to revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our mission is to craft compelling marketing campaigns that not only captivate but also convert. Our brands are some of the fastest growing brands in the DTC space that are in the health and wellness space. With creativity at our core, we strive to push the boundaries of ecommerce marketing, making an indelible impact on the industry. Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Video Editor to join our dynamic team for a full time role. This individual will play a crucial role in post-production video editing, creating engaging and effective video assets that resonate with our target audiences and drive purchases for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate will have a blend of creative talent, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of ecommerce marketing. Qualifications: At least 2 years of experience in video editing within the ecommerce marketing space, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work. Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and Davinci. Solid understanding of key metrics like hook rate, hold rate, and click through rate, and expertise in creating short-form direct response videos. A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous. Agency experience is a plus Experience using AI tools like Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, and others BONUS: If you can create your own videos based on the brand data (winners, angles, content that’s working) - we pay out bonuses for this type of work Fluency in English is required. Key Competencies: Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts. Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality video assets. A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in video editing and content creation. Ability to utilize AI tools in the editing process as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative. Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content. A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns. You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on. Overview: As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in video editing will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones. Roles and Responsibilities: Video Editing: You will be responsible for editing raw footage into polished content for Meta & TikTok. This involves cutting hooks effectively, creating a cohesive story through the video content, and making the video engaging and effective to drive higher thumb stop rates (staying past the first 3 seconds), longer hold times (watching for at least 15 seconds), and high click through rates. Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack. Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, storytelling elements, and visual style is highly valued. Project Management: Manage your video editing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress. Quality Control: Ensure all videos meet ACTIV’s quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok. Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better. Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team. Working Hours: This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone. Expectations: Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report. Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines. Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines. Tools and Software: Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected. Compensation: The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role: Compensation: Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application. Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it. Expectations and Growth: This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. This growth path is supported by a clear compensation and bonus structure that rewards high performance and the achievement of key milestones in ad spend supported by the content produced. We believe this structure will motivate our Video Editor to continuously strive for excellence, producing content that not only captivates audiences but also significantly contributes to the success of our e-commerce clients' campaigns. To Apply: To apply for this role, you will need to fill out this form that is 27 questions in total. ---------- You will then be asked to do a short project that displays your work with a loose brief and video resources provided showing your ability to take a brief and create a strong video creative from it. Once we review your video, we will set up an interview to the qualified candidates and then if you meet our standards then we would make a job offer.

description: Mudcrab Hatchery Operations Manager Location: Himamaylan, Negros Occidental Reports To: Farm Owner Employment Type: Full-Time, Operational (requires on-call availability) About the Role: We are seeking a master of metamorphosis. This is not a routine farm management position; it is a highly specialized, science-driven role responsible for the most delicate phase of the mudcrab lifecycle. The Hatchery Operations Manager will orchestrate the entire hatchery process, from broodstock maturation to the delivery of healthy, robust crablets (megalopa/crabeon stage). You will blend deep knowledge of decapod biology with industrial facility management to solve a singular, critical challenge: reliably producing life at scale. Key Responsibilities: 1. Production Mastery & Larval Rearing Broodstock & Spawning: Manage the entire reproductive cycle, including broodstock selection, health assessment, conditioning, and spawning induction (including unilateral eyestalk ablation where applicable) of Scylla serrata and related species. Larval Lifecycle Management: Oversee the critical and fragile transition through all zoea stages (Z1-Z5) to megalopa and finally to crabelet. This includes managing metamorphosis, identifying staging in real-time, and adjusting protocols instantly. Live Feed Command: Direct the high-density, axenic (zero-contamination) production of the entire live feed chain—intensive microalgae (Nannochloropsis, Chaetoceros, Tetraselmis), rotifers (Brachionus), and Artemia—with a focus on targeted enrichment profiles (e.g., HUFA, Vitamin C) for each larval stage. 2. Industrial Systems & Water Quality Management Life Support Systems: Assume ownership of all Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and flow-through infrastructure. This includes hands-on troubleshooting and preventative maintenance of pumps, biofilters, protein skimmers, UV sterilizers, heaters/chillers, and emergency backup systems. Parameter Precision: Maintain a non-negotiable, 24/7 stable environment by monitoring and reacting to critical parameters: temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia, nitrite, and alkalinity. Calibrate automated probes against manual titration methods regularly. 3. Biosecurity & Veterinary Health Disease Prevention: Act as the first line of defense. Implement and enforce a fortress-style biosecurity plan to prevent catastrophic events from pathogens like luminous vibriosis, Lagenidium fungus, and ciliates. Health Diagnostics: Perform daily microscopic health checks on larvae, identify early signs of stress, bacterial blooms, or necrosis, and execute rapid, decisive treatment protocols. Sanitation Protocols: Enforce rigorous dry-out, disinfection, and sterilization cycles for all tanks, equipment, and facilities between production runs. 4. Data, Science, and Continuous Improvement Forensic Record-Keeping: Maintain a meticulous, "black box" of data for every production run: survival rates by stage, daily feeding regimes, water chemistry logs, and growth metrics. This data is used to diagnose failures and replicate success. R&D for Cannibalism Mitigation: Lead ongoing applied research trials to crack the code on the megalopa-to-crablet bottleneck. This includes innovating with shelter designs (substrates, mesh structures), optimizing stocking densities, and manipulating environmental cues to reduce aggressive behavior and maximize survival. 5. Leadership & Emergency Response Team Leadership: Train and lead a small, dedicated team of technicians. Instill a culture of precision, cleanliness, and acute observation. Crisis Management: This is a 24/7 life-support operation. The manager must be mentally prepared to wake up, diagnose a failing pump, a drop in dissolved oxygen, or a disease outbreak, and make life-or-death decisions for millions of animals under extreme pressure. Candidate Profile: Are You One of the Few? Essential Technical Mastery Decapod Science: Deep, applied understanding of crustacean endocrinology, molting physiology, and nutritional pathology. Aquatic Engineering: You can rebuild a pump, wire a float switch, sweat PVC pipe, and diagnose a short-circuited blower. You are as comfortable with a wrench as with a microscope. Microscopic Eye: You can quickly identify a healthy Z3 larva from a bacterially infected one, and spot the difference between a rotifer and a ciliate bloom under a scope. Required Background Education: BSc or MSc in Aquaculture, Marine Biology, or related field. A proven track record can substitute for a degree. Experience: Minimum 5+ years in a marine hatchery, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Specialized Track Record: Must have direct, verifiable, hands-on experience closing the lifecycle of a decapod crustacean (mudcrab, swimming crab, shrimp/prawn). Experience with Scylla is the gold standard. Personal Attributes The "Biological Clock": You have an intuitive sense for the rhythm of a hatchery; you "feel" when something is wrong before the alarms go off. Resilient Problem-Solver: You remain calm and logical when a production run crashes, immediately shifting to root-cause analysis and solution mode. Guardian of Biosecurity: You have a slightly obsessive mindset about cleanliness and contamination control.

Hours & working style: Remote, full-time. We move fast and I need you reachable and actively working during core hours, CET time zone. I care about responsiveness and shipped results, not clock-watching. Compensation: Base Retainer (Months 1-3): $600 USD / month Base Retainer (Month 4+): $800 USD / month (based on performance) Maximum Monthly Earnings: Up to $2,000 USD / month (base + bonuses) Paid monthly via Wise. All tools, AI subscriptions, and API credits are covered by me; you provide your own computer and internet. title: Humbly Confident YouTube Video Editor
description: WHO WE ARE We're a small, fast-growing web design agency that works primarily with coaches and expertise-based businesses. We help them grow their businesses through beautiful, strategic web design and marketing. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for a skilled Video Editor to join our team and own the editing of our agency's YouTube channel and short-form social content. This content is how we market ourselves and attract new clients, so your work will directly help us grow. Currently, the owner (that's me, Jennie) films talking-head educational videos and tutorials for service businesses, expertise-based businesses, and online businesses (think coaches, consultants, and more). I handle the filming, scripting, and rough cuts. That means I remove the bad takes and mark up the script with notes on where I think B-roll, graphics, or visual interest should go. What I need from you is the creative expertise to take that foundation and make it *good*. You'll bring the pacing, transitions, motion graphics, text overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling that turn an educational talking-head video into something people actually want to watch. This role is primarily focused on long-form YouTube content, with additional light editing on short-form clips (Reels, Shorts, etc.) for our social channels. We'd like to get to 2–3 long-form videos a month and work our way toward weekly long-form over time. I need someone who can grow with us. You'll report directly to me and collaborate with our team as needed. We'll connect via Zoom as needed, and you're welcome to work normal hours in your time zone. RESPONSIBILITIES Your job will be to use your past experience to: - Edit 2–3 long-form YouTube videos per month from pre-cut raw footage and a marked-up script, working our way toward weekly long-form over time - Edit approximately 3–5 short-form video clips per week (Reels, Shorts). These are light edits, mostly clipping b-roll I record for funny reels and adding text to them - Add motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, B-roll suggestions, and sound design that make educational content visually engaging - Bring your own creative perspective. I'll give you editorial notes, but I'm not a video editor, so I really appreciate you bringing your creative eye on what will keep viewers watching - Maintain meticulous quality control. That means catching audio issues, awkward cuts, mismatched graphics, typos in text overlays, and anything that doesn't feel polished - Deliver final files on schedule so our publishing workflow stays on track - Occasionally support a small number of client video projects with similar editing work - Optional: Create thumbnails for YouTube videos. A great plus, but not required! EXPERIENCE We care more about a high skill level than years of experience, but we expect that you have at least 2 years of experience editing video content, ideally for YouTube or other social platforms. You're proficient with professional editing software. We prefer tools like Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, but we're open to your preferred tool as long as the output is professional quality. You have a strong eye for pacing and visual storytelling in educational, talking-head content. You know how to keep a viewer engaged through smart cuts, well-timed graphics, and visual variety, even when the core content is someone talking to a camera. You can work with motion graphics and text overlays confidently. Meaning you should be comfortable creating clean lower thirds and simple graphic elements that make the content easier to follow. You have meticulous QA habits. You catch audio sync issues, color inconsistencies, typos in on-screen text and awkward transitions before anything is delivered. Oh, and you get a little thrill when the video you edited becomes an outlier video for the channel! You're not shy about being (humbly) confident enough to push back and share your creative opinion. If you think a cut isn't working, a graphic would help, or the pacing needs to change, I want to hear it. We encourage that. You're comfortable collaborating using Google Drive and Zoom, and optionally Notion for our content calendar. HOW WE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED We want you to succeed in this role. We will provide any additional training you may need to get on board and hit the ground running. We're not going to teach you how to edit video because your past experience will serve you well. However, we will train you regarding our brand, our audience, our content style, and our workflow so you can apply your skills to help us achieve our mission. We will listen to you encourage you to bring your entire self to work. We are humans first, work colleagues second. EMPLOYMENT TYPE This is a flexible role based on the time it takes to deliver the expected output (2–3 long-form videos per month + 3–5 short-form clips per week). That may be full-time for you, or it may not. We're open to discussing what works. We're not looking for an agency. Please begin your cover letter with the title of one of the videos on our YouTube channel at ----------

title: Scheduler
description: Job Description: Under the general supervision of the Service Administrator, the Service Coordinator is a critical role responsible for proactively building positive relationships and providing personal, responsive service and attention to our caregivers, our clients, and their families. The Service Coordinator’s primary responsibility is to efficiently match clients with caregivers, ensuring continuity of care, and delivering exceptional customer service. Key Responsibilities: • Efficiently schedule caregivers to match them with clients, taking into account preferences, availability, and skills. • Handle daily changes in client schedules and caregiver call-offs with a sense of urgency, ensuring immediate replacement. • Collaborate with Care Coordinators and other Service Coordinators to establish consistent caregiving teams for clients. • Maintain open and effective communication with caregivers, clients, and their families, promptly addressing any scheduling conflicts or changes. • Update client’s schedules and details when needed and follow through to ensure everyone is communicated with properly. • Ensure the caregiver’s credentials match client’s needs. • Provide excellent customer service by being kind, genuine, and attentive to client and caregiver needs. • Act as a critical thinker, able to see the bigger picture in terms of scheduling and client care. • Adhere to company policies and procedures, including the use of scheduling software, Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom and maintaining accurate records. • Continuously strive for operational excellence and success in your role as a Service Coordinator. This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive.  The employee will be expected to perform other reasonable related duties as assigned. Core Qualities and Attributes 1. Efficiency: Service Coordinators manage complex schedules, so they should be efficient in organizing and optimizing caregiver-client matches to ensure seamless service delivery. 2. Clear Communication: Effective communication with caregivers, clients, and their families is vital to handle scheduling changes and conflicts promptly and maintain transparency. 3. Adaptability: Scheduling can be dynamic, so Service Coordinators adapt to changing circumstances and adjust schedules accordingly. 4. Attention to Detail: Precision is crucial to ensure that caregivers are matched appropriately with clients and that schedules are error-free. 5. Sense of Urgency: Service Coordinators respond quickly to client scheduling needs and caregiver call-offs to maintain continuity of care. 6. Empathy: A compassionate approach when dealing with clients and caregivers fosters positive relationships and enhances the overall care experience. 7. Problem-Solving Skills: Service Coordinators are critical thinkers who can identify and resolve scheduling issues efficiently. 8. Customer Service Orientation: They must provide exceptional customer service to clients and caregivers, ensuring their needs are met and expectations are exceeded. 9. Reliability: Clients and caregivers depend on Service Coordinators to ensure consistent care, so reliability is crucial. 10. Technology Proficiency: Familiarity with scheduling software (e.g., Outlook, Microsoft Teams), as well as basic Microsoft Word and Excel skills, can help streamline scheduling tasks. 11. Responsible and Accountable: Service Coordinators are responsible for maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with company policies and labor laws. 12. Passion for In-Home Care: Having a genuine passion for making a positive impact in the field of in-home care is essential for motivating and driving success in this role. 13. Hardworking: Service Coordinators should be dedicated and hardworking individuals who are committed to the success of the caregiving team. 14. Kindness: A kind and compassionate demeanor can go a long way in building positive relationships with clients and caregivers, creating a nurturing care environment. Key Success Factors for the Scheduler Role In summary, the Scheduler plays a crucial role in ensuring the seamless coordination of caregivers and clients, building continuity in care, and providing exceptional customer service. Success in this role involves efficient scheduling, clear communication, employee satisfaction, meeting client needs, and strict adherence to company policies. Required Skills / Abilities: • Active communication techniques including listening, expressing ideas and concerns, questioning and presenting. • Is responsive to the needs of others and is a team player who demonstrates a commitment to co-workers and to company vision, values and goals. • Proficiency in Microsoft Windows. • High level of judgement and confidentiality related to client privacy and HIPAA compliance. • The ability to manage competing demands and adapt quickly and positively to frequent changes, delays or unexpected events. • Attention to detail, completing and documenting tasks and interactions in a thorough manner. Education and Experience: • High School diploma or GED and two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. • Must be able to successfully pass a nationwide criminal background check. • Must possess a valid driver’s license and have access to reliable transportation.

description: Title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote) Role We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result. About us We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes. How we work We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review. This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code. What you will do - Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely. - Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable. - Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps. Requirements - Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely). - Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself. - Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase. - Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input). - Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow. - Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders. - Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday. Nice to have - AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features). - Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds. - Multi-tenant SaaS experience. Trial (before any production access) We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront. You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit. How to apply (English, no template letters) 1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep. 2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it? 3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code. 4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith? 5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records? 6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects. Do not apply if - You are not the person who will do the work. - You ship AI output without verification. - You cannot describe your workflow concretely. - You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase. - You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Lead Research & Enrichment Specialist
description: We run an outbound sales motion that targets home services businesses (roofing, HVAC, solar, pool, windows, flooring, landscaping, and similar). This role is the human quality layer between a raw prospect list and a 1:1 cold email — the difference between outreach that gets ignored and outreach that books calls. You'll take raw prospect exports, qualify each one against our ideal-customer profile, verify a reachable decision-maker, audit the prospect's full digital presence, and write a sharp, personalized opener that proves we actually studied their business. We have a fully documented SOP; your job is to run it accurately, consistently, and with judgment. This is detail-heavy, repetitive work that directly drives revenue. If you take pride in doing careful research well and writing clean, natural English, you'll do well here. - Qualify each prospect against our ICP — confirm they're a real, active home services business that fits our offer - Run a contact-method waterfall to find and verify a reachable owner/decision-maker (email first, then phone, then active social), and disqualify cleanly when no clean contact path exists - Audit each qualified prospect's digital presence: > Website (legitimacy, location match, social links) > Meta Ad Library — whether they're running ads, how many, where the ads point, and a screenshot snippet > Google Ads Transparency Center — same, plus whether a marketing agency is listed > Facebook / Instagram — follower counts, activity level, noteworthy recent posts - Capture all of this as structured data in Airtable, with no missing or unverified fields - Classify each prospect's advertising maturity (e.g., None / Dabbling / Established / Scaling / Heavy) so we can match the right outreach angle - Write a personalized 1–2 sentence icebreaker for each qualified lead that clearly reflects a manual review of their business - Maintain pipeline hygiene — update each record's status accurately so leads move to the correct stage automatically Tools you'll use (Prior experience with any of these is a plus, but we'll train you on our exact workflow. A documented step-by-step SOP is provided.): - Apollo - Airtable - Meta Ad Library - Google Ads Transparency Center - LinkedIn - Facebook / Instagram What we're looking for (requirements): - Excellent written English. You will write customer-facing copy. This is the single most important skill for the role — openers must read as natural and specific, never templated. - Meticulous attention to detail and consistency across hundreds of records - A resourceful researcher — you can find an owner's email or profile when it isn't handed to you - Basic understanding of digital advertising (what a Facebook /Google ad is, what "running ads" signals about a business) - Self-managed and reliable — comfortable owning a structured, repetitive process and hitting daily targets without hand-holding - Stable internet connection Nice to have: - Prior lead generation, list-building, or cold email experience - Familiarity with the home services industry - Hands-on Airtable experience How we measure success: - Throughput: ramp to ~40 qualified-and-enriched leads per day once trained - Qualification accuracy: a low rate of poor-fit or unreachable leads slipping through to outreach - Icebreaker quality: openers that read as genuinely researched and specific to each business - Data completeness: every required field populated and verified — no blanks, no guesses Logistics: - Hours: 35/ week - Rate: $4 - $6 per hour - Start date: As soon as possible

title: Learn Management System implementation specialist
description: # Job Description: Learning Management System Specialist ## Position Overview Nexlar is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Learning Management System Specialist to help build, organize, improve, and manage our online training platform. This person will be responsible for setting up the learning management system, uploading courses, improving course content, organizing training materials, managing certificates, and ensuring the system is easy to use for students, employees, and administrators. The ideal candidate should have experience working with learning management systems, online course platforms, training content, certificates, and basic technical setup. This role requires strong organization, attention to detail, creativity, and the ability to improve the learning experience. ## Key Responsibilities ### Learning Management System Setup Set up and configure the learning management system according to company needs. Organize the platform structure, including courses, modules, lessons, quizzes, users, categories, and learning paths. Customize the LMS settings, branding, navigation, permissions, and user roles. Make sure the system is easy to access, professional-looking, and simple for users to navigate. Troubleshoot basic LMS issues and coordinate with technical support when needed. ### Course Uploading and Organization Upload course materials, including videos, PDFs, presentations, documents, quizzes, assignments, and other training content. Organize courses into clear modules and lessons. Ensure all uploaded materials are properly labeled, formatted, and easy to follow. Review uploaded content to confirm that links, videos, quizzes, and downloads are working correctly. Maintain a clean and professional course layout. ### Course Improvement and Content Development Review existing courses and recommend improvements to make them more engaging, professional, and effective. Improve course structure, wording, visuals, formatting, quizzes, and learning flow. Help convert raw training materials into polished online courses. Create or improve course descriptions, learning objectives, lesson summaries, and instructions. Identify gaps in course content and suggest additional materials where needed. ### Certificates and Completion Tracking Set up certificates of completion for courses and training programs. Customize certificate templates with company branding, student names, course names, completion dates, and signatures if required. Configure automatic certificate generation upon course completion. Track learner progress, course completion, quiz results, and certificate issuance. Generate reports related to course activity, user progress, and training completion. ### User Management and Support Add, organize, and manage users inside the LMS. Assign users to the correct courses or training programs. Help users with login issues, course access, certificates, and general LMS navigation. Provide basic instructions or guides for students, employees, and administrators. Maintain accurate records of course enrollment and completion. ### Quality Control Test courses before publishing to ensure everything works properly. Check videos, links, quizzes, certificates, forms, and downloadable materials. Ensure course content is accurate, professional, and aligned with company standards. Maintain consistency across all courses and certificates. ## Required Skills and Experience Experience working with a learning management system or online course platform. Ability to upload and organize online courses, videos, documents, quizzes, and training materials. Experience setting up certificates, completion rules, and course tracking. Strong attention to detail and organization. Ability to improve course content, layout, and user experience. Basic technical troubleshooting skills. Good written communication skills. Ability to work independently and complete tasks on schedule. Familiarity with online training, e-learning, instructional design, or course development is preferred. ## Preferred Experience Experience with platforms such as Moodle, TalentLMS, LearnDash, Kajabi, Thinkific, Teachable, Canvas, Docebo, Absorb LMS, or similar systems. Basic graphic design or formatting skills. Experience creating quizzes, assessments, and certificates. Experience improving training content for employees, customers, or students. Knowledge of SCORM, course completion rules, automation, or reporting tools is a plus. ## Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, reliable, creative, and comfortable working with technology. They should be able to take existing training materials and turn them into professional online courses. They should also be able to manage the LMS, improve the learning experience, and make sure users receive certificates after completing their training. ## Job Type Full-time, part-time, or contract depending on experience and availability. ## Work Location Remote or hybrid, depending on company needs.

All must be architected in from day one so they can be switched on without a rebuild. This is a non-negotiable requirement. • Payment processing via Stripe — integrated but dormant at launch, activatable for subscriptions, one-time purchases, and transaction fees • Tiered user badge system — free and paid badge types must be supported in the data model from day one; new badge types must be addable without schema changes • Ad slot architecture — designated injectable ad placements in the feed (between posts), at the top and bottom of key screens, and within browse/discovery views; placements must be swappable between house content and third-party ad network (e.g. Google AdMob) without UI rebuilds • Modular map/globe component — the map view must be built as a fully modular component so that multiple independent map instances can be added later (e.g. a separate map layer for partner businesses, local deals, or events) without rearchitecting the core feature • Premium user tier support — the user model must support a premium flag from day one; gating logic for features such as increased listing limits, promoted visibility, and boosted content must be implementable by flipping a config, not rewriting components • Business/partner account type — the user model must support a separate account type for businesses or organisations, distinct from individual user accounts, activatable post-launch • Promoted content slots — listings and profiles must support a promoted/sponsored flag in the data model so boosted content can be surfaced in feeds and discovery views without UI changes Technical Requirements We are open to React Native (Expo) or Flutter — we trust you to propose the framework you are most confident shipping great consumer apps in. What matters is the outcome, not the framework. The remaining tools below are strongly preferred and candidates should have direct experience with them or clear equivalents. Preferred stack (open to discussion) • React Native (Expo) or Flutter — we are open to either, single codebase for iOS and Android. Tell us which you recommend and why in your application. • Supabase — Postgres database, Auth, Realtime, and Storage • Supabase Realtime for live data sync (map pins, session status, chat) • Mapbox SDK or Google Maps SDK for the globe/map feature — Mapbox strongly preferred for globe rendering • Expo Notifications + OneSignal for push notifications • Stripe for payment architecture (integration required, activation deferred) • Clerk or Supabase Auth for Google and Apple sign-in Required experience • Minimum 3 published apps in the App Store or Google Play — links required in application • Prior experience building real-time features (live maps, chat, activity feeds) • Prior experience building consumer social or marketplace apps • Clean, maintainable, well-commented code — we will review code samples before hiring • Experience with App Store and Google Play submission and review processes • TypeScript preferred Engagement Terms This is a full-time engagement We are not looking for someone to work on this between other projects. We need a developer or team who will treat this as their primary focus for the duration of the build. We expect 35–40 hours per week minimum during the active build phase. Timeline • Active build phase: approximately 4–5 months • Post-launch maintenance and feature development: ongoing, long-term • We expect the winning candidate to be available for at least 12 months total Post-launch expectations • Bug fixes and OS compatibility updates as iOS and Android release new versions • App Store compliance updates as Apple and Google update policies • Feature additions on a rolling roadmap we will define together post-launch • Availability for urgent issues within 24 hours Preferred candidate type • Small agency (2–4 people) or a senior lead developer with a trusted sub-contractor network • Someone who has seen a project from zero to App Store before — multiple times • Fluent written English is required — you will be communicating with US-based founders daily How to Apply We receive a high volume of applications and filter aggressively. To be considered, your application must include all of the following. Applications missing any item will not receive a response. Required in your application • Links to at least 3 live apps you have built in the App Store or Google Play. Not screenshots, not videos — actual downloadable app links. • A brief description of the most technically complex app you have shipped and specifically what made it complex. • Your experience with Supabase Realtime specifically. If you have not used it, tell us what real-time tool you have used instead and why. • Your experience with map or globe integrations in a mobile app — Mapbox or Google Maps. Describe what you built. • Confirmation that you are available full-time and can begin within 2 weeks. • Your proposed hourly rate or monthly retainer for the build phase, and your expected rate for the ongoing maintenance phase. Please also include a proposed schedule of deliverables with estimated milestones and your projected timeline to completion. We expect weekly or biweekly check-in calls with the founding team and ask that you confirm you are available for these. • To confirm you have read this posting in full, begin your application with the phrase: “Mobile ready.” Applications that do not start with this phrase will not be reviewed. Shortlisting process: Top applicants will be invited to a 30-minute video call. Following the call, finalists will be given a small paid test task (compensated at your stated rate) before a final offer is made. We will not ask you to work for free at any stage. What We Offer • Competitive hourly rate or monthly retainer — we pay fairly for quality • Full product specification document and Figma designs provided on day one — no guessing what to build • Direct access to founders for fast decision-making — no corporate approval chains • Long-term relationship — if you do great work, you will have work for years • Milestone-based payments through Upwork escrow — protected for both sides • A genuinely interesting, well-scoped product with real market potential in a growing category We are serious founders building a serious product. When a hospital is considering our system, we analyze photos and walkthrough videos of their current sterile storage rooms, count and measure everything on their shelves, and produce a data-driven proposal showing exactly how much space they will gain with SteriRack. You will be the engine of that analysis. What You Will Do - Analyze site photos and walkthrough videos of hospital sterile storage rooms, pausing/screenshotting video to inspect each bay of shelving. - Count and classify surgical instrument trays into height categories (4", 6", 8"+, and long trays) using visual estimation — wrapped trays, rigid containers, and peel-pack pouches. - Estimate soft goods volume (sterile items packaged in bags/pouches) and translate it into basket capacity. - Complete our Facts & Data workbook (Excel) for each project: tray counts per cart/bay, in-service growth factor, total trays, baskets needed (e.g., 400x600, doublewide), number of SteriRack bays, and elevation assignments. - Flag ambiguous items — when an angle, blur, or obstruction prevents a confident count, document it and ask rather than guess. - Support proposal output: your data feeds the customer-facing summary showing storage capacity gained. Over time you may help build the bay/elevation layouts and gain-summary documents themselves. - Log hours in Jibble and attend a short daily check-in with the U.S. team. What Success Looks Like: - Counts are accurate and consistent — two analysts looking at the same photo should land within a tray or two of each other. - Workbooks are complete, clean, and delivered on schedule (typically 1–3 business days per facility survey). - Ambiguities are flagged, not buried. Who We're Looking For Required: - Strong visual/spatial estimation — comfortable judging item heights and quantities from photos and video. - High attention to detail and tolerance for repetitive, methodical screen work. - Solid Excel skills (data entry, basic formulas; you don't need to be a formula wizard — the workbook does the math). - Strong written English; able to write clear notes and questions. - Reliable home office: fast internet (?25 Mbps), a computer that can smoothly play/scrub HD video, dual monitors preferred. - Able to work U.S. East Coast (EST) hours, full-time. Strongly preferred backgrounds (any one of these): - Quantity takeoff / construction estimating assistant - CAD drafting or design assistant (architecture, kitchens/closets, millwork) - Inventory control, warehouse slotting, or supply chain analysis - Medical records, medical coding, or claims photo review - Sterile processing (SPD/CSSD) or OR materials experience — a big plus; you'll already know what a rigid container vs. a wrapped tray vs. a peel pack looks like - Not required: an engineering degree, U.S. healthcare experience, or sales skills. This is an analysis role, not a phone role. Compensation & Terms - ?70,000–?100,000/month based on experience and trial performance - Independent contractor agreement; paid 2-week working trial; 12-month renewable term after the trial - Hours logged via Jibble; performance reviewed against accuracy and turnaround benchmarks How to Apply - Submit the following (applications without the video will not be considered): - A 2–3 minute video (or audio if camera is unavailable) introducing yourself: your background, the most detail-oriented work you've done, and why overnight EST hours work for your situation. Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted link is fine. - Your resume/CV. - One sentence describing your internet speed and computer setup (include a screenshot of a speedtest.net result if possible).

Our customers book online, communicate with us by text and phone, and pick up their vehicles without ever standing at a counter. That means our virtual reps ARE the customer experience — fast, sharp, and friendly over text and voice. ## What You’ll Do - Sell and support rentals via text message and phone — converting inquiries into bookings, handling upsells (vehicle upgrades, insurance, prepaid fuel, add-ons), and resolving customer questions in real time - Work across multiple systems simultaneously: our rental management software, business texting platform, phone system, and payment/charge automation tools - Perform risk-based assessments on reservations — reviewing customer and payment details, flagging high-risk bookings, and applying pre-authorization and verification policies to protect the company from fraud and chargebacks - Process payments, deposits, and payment requests accurately - Keep reservation records clean, complete, and well-documented - Communicate clearly and professionally in writing — most of your selling happens over text ## What We’re Looking For - **Prior car rental experience would be great** — virtual or in-person (counter agent, reservations, sales, or operations) - Comfortable and effective selling over text and phone — you can build rapport and close without face-to-face contact - Able to juggle multiple software systems at once without dropping balls (rental management systems, SMS platforms, payment tools — experience with TSD or similar a plus) - Strong judgment for risk assessment — you can spot a sketchy booking and know when to verify, escalate, or decline - Excellent written communication — fast, clear, professional texting - Self-managed and reliable in a remote environment - Available within our operating hours (Sun–Fri, 6 AM–10 PM AZ time) with flexibility to work varying shifts assigned each week ## Nice to Have - Sales performance track record (upsell/ancillary penetration metrics) - Experience with contactless or remote rental operations ## Schedule & Compensation - Part-time and full-time positions available - Shifts fall within Sunday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM Arizona time - Schedules are set weekly — we need flexibility on which shifts you’re assigned - Competitive pay ## How to Apply Send a short note about your car rental experience and your availability. Bonus points if you tell us about a time you closed a sale or de-escalated a customer entirely over text.

title: Senior Backend Java Engineer
description: Job Overview About the Company: We are a U.S.-based software company dedicated to the mortgage industry. We build reliable, scalable systems that support mission-critical servicing workflows. Our engineering culture values technical excellence, long-term ownership, and clear execution. We operate in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where experienced engineers are trusted to make architectural decisions and drive the product forward. Position Overview: We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Backend Java Developer to join our core engineering team. This is a role for a professional who thrives on building large-scale, robust server-side systems and is looking for a stable, long-term home. You will have significant responsibility for architecting complex Java backends, optimizing data pipelines, and ensuring the scalability of our cloud infrastructure. Please Note: We are looking for a teammate who is fully committed and ready to dedicate their professional focus to our mission. To streamline our compliance and operational workflows, this specific role is strictly targeted toward talent residing in the Philippines. Key Responsibilities Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable services using Java and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Architecture & APIs: Architect and scale robust APIs and microservices using both GraphQL and REST. Data Modeling: Design and optimize DynamoDB schemas, queries, and indexing strategies to support heavy transactional workloads. System Integrity: Improve backend system reliability, observability, logging, and fault tolerance within an event-driven architecture. Cloud Infrastructure: Leverage AWS cloud services to deploy, monitor, and maintain backend applications securely. Leadership: Lead technical code reviews, enforce backend engineering best practices, and mentor junior developers. Required Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of professional backend software development experience. Core Backend: Deep expertise in Java and the Spring Boot ecosystem. API & Data: Proven experience with GraphQL, RESTful APIs, and DynamoDB (or similar NoSQL databases). Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS services (including Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, and DynamoDB). Reliability: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (unit, integration), and DevOps practices. Commitment: Proven track record of dedication to a team and the ability to manage a full-time workload effectively. Interview Integrity: Zero-tolerance policy for AI-assisted responses or external help during our technical evaluation process. Preferred Qualifications Experience with distributed messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC). Strong understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and CQRS patterns. Why Join Us? Stability & Growth: Competitive salary aligned with your experience level ($12–$17/hour). Flexibility: 100% remote work environment. Impact: High level of ownership and technical influence over a mission-critical platform. Culture: A collaborative team with high engineering standards and no "red tape." How to Apply If you are a dedicated backend developer looking for a long-term role where your contributions truly matter, please apply with your updated resume and a brief summary of your experience with robust Java architectures. Important Verification Step: As part of our secure onboarding process and to confirm geographic compliance with local employment guidelines, all applicants must provide a clear copy of a valid government-issued photo ID prior to scheduling the initial interview. Applications submitted without a verifiable photo ID will not be considered.

Error Handling Infrastructure: Implement strict catch-and-retry error boundaries to ensure critical software automations don't silently fail during high-volume transfers. Documentation: Write pristine internal runbooks for every workflow you build so the system logic is easily maintained as we scale. Requirements: Technical Footprint: 3+ years of dedicated experience managing advanced Zapier architectures, webhooks, and raw REST API endpoints. Platform Literacy: Deep familiarity with data formatting (JSON parsing, arrays) and foundational web mechanics. Experience deploying custom JavaScript or Python snippets inside "Code by Zapier" steps is a massive advantage. Flawless English Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English. You must be able to explain technical data flows clearly and collaborate with the engineering team. Self-Governance: You are a strategic builder who values data accuracy, tests automations systematically before shipping, and doesn't require constant micromanagement. How to Apply: To filter out automated bot submissions, generic template cover letters will be immediately deleted. To apply, reply to this posting with the exact subject line: "Integration Expert: [Insert Your Total Years of Zapier Experience]" and include the following: A brief overview of the most complex, multi-step API/Zapier integration workflow you have personally architected from scratch. In your own words, briefly explain the difference between a polling trigger and a webhook trigger inside Zapier, and when you would use custom code instead of a native app step. A link to your updated resume. A quick 60-second video intro (Loom/Zoom link) introducing yourself and outlining your backend integration experience.
