description: REMOTE BOOKKEEPER / BOOKKEEPING ASSISTANT — Functional Nutriments (Team Dog) THE SHORT VERSION We're a small group of U.S.-based, dog-focused companies looking for a sharp, dependable bookkeeper to work alongside our senior bookkeeper of nearly ten years. You'll own the day-to-day transactional work in QuickBooks Online across four related entities, so she can focus on the close, the reconciliations, and the judgment calls. This is a long-term, fully remote role for someone who chose accounting on purpose and takes quiet pride in books that tie out to the penny. WHO WE ARE Functional Nutriments makes science-backed supplements for dogs. We're part of a small family of related businesses: a dog supplement company, an independent dog-health information site, a podcast network for dog lovers, and a publishing imprint. Our people (we think of ourselves as "Team Dog") are all fully remote professionals who live across several countries and time zones. We've operated this way for over twenty years. We're real and findable. (You're encouraged to look us up.) We treat the people who work with us like long-term partners. Some have been here for over a decade. WHAT YOU'LL DO *  Categorize bank and credit-card feed transactions in QuickBooks Online, correctly and consistently *  Enter accounts-payable bills and accounts-receivable invoices *  Pull monthly revenue reports from Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, and PayPal and prep them for reconciliation *  Vendor and W-9 administration, receipt collection, and document filing *  Reconciliation prep and running reports for the senior bookkeeper's review *  Flag anything that looks off — and ask before you guess You will not be alone. A senior bookkeeper reviews the work and there's a clear escalation path. We want someone who can grow into more over time. WHAT WE GENUINELY NEED (please read this part >>>) The single most important thing: you actually understand double-entry bookkeeping, not just the software. You know why undeposited funds exists, what a prepaid expense is and how it amortizes, why a refund doesn't go to the same account as a sale, and what to do when a deposit has no matching invoice. If a step exists, you understand why it exists. We'll happily teach you our books; we can't teach you bookkeeping itself. Required: *  Solid working grasp of double-entry fundamentals (accrual basis, debits/credits, accruals, prepaids, the matching principle) *  At least 2 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including real QuickBooks Online work where you have owned the monthly books or close for at least one business (not just isolated data entry) *  Strong, clear written English — you'll communicate mostly in writing but video calls are a real thing within Team Dog *  Real attention to detail and the discipline to leave a clean audit trail *  Reliability and good async communication: you do what you say, and you flag problems early *  A quiet home work setup and stable internet and power Nice to have (not required): *  E-commerce bookkeeping experience (Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Wise) *  Experience with multiple entities or intercompany transactions *  QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification THE DETAILS *  Long-term independent contractor, fully remote *  About 20 hours/week to start, with genuine room to grow toward full-time *  USD$500-$700/month ($6 to $8/hour) depending on experience, with room to grow; paid twice per month via Wise *  Flexible schedule, with some overlap with U.S. Pacific/Hawaii hours for monthly close HOW TO APPLY — AND HOW WE HIRE We keep this simple and human: 1.  Apply here with your resume and a few sentences about your bookkeeping experience and why this role fits you. Include the word "ledger" in your note so we know you read the full post. Bonus points if you tell us about a special dog in your life. 2.  A short online skills screen (about 20 minutes, free). If your note and background look like a fit, we'll send you a personal message with a link to a quick, auto-graded screen covering bookkeeping fundamentals and QuickBooks — with a welcome video from our founder, so you know exactly who you're dealing with. 3.  A paid working interview. Our strongest candidates do a short, paid working session with us. PLUS you'll be compensated for your time as we walk through a real-world scenario and hear how you think. A real company, a real person on the other end, and we pay you for the practical stage. We're hiring one person and we intend to keep them for years. If that's the role you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description: OVERVIEW Consult Lemonade is seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO. This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead. This is not an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders. SCHEDULE * Part-time position * Monday through Friday * 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST * Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows LEADING PEOPLE You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction. Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on Consult Lemonade's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity. DELIVERING RESULTS * CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance. * Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action. * CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses. * Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented. * Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised. * Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis. * Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time. * Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system. * Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality. * Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution. COMMUNICATION * Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests, email communications, and external inquiries. * Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks. * Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation. * Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations. * Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment. * Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up. STRATEGIC THINKING * Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management. * Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives. * Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to Consult Lemonade's mission and programs. * Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness. ACCOUNTABILITY * Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports. * Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan. * Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems. * Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met. * Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role. * Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership. * Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience. * Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously. * Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment. * Strong organizational and project management skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems. * Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency. * High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment. * Strong alignment with Consult Lemonade's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management. * Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities. * Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives. * Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team. * Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms. IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization. HOW TO APPLY To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following: 1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position. 2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience. 3. A detailed introduction video that includes: * Your Executive Assistant experience * The executives or leaders you have supported * Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed * Why you are interested in this opportunity * Why you believe you are a strong fit for Consult Lemonade 4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered. Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is a critical part of this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

description: About Us We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. title: $10/hour: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Scheduler (TikTok/Reels)
description: Hi, I'm Andrew. I run two e-commerce brands and a personal channel. Yesterday alone, one video I created hit 2M+ views on IG, and I'm looking for a coachable long-term video editor to keep the virality spree going. You'll be directly tasked with creating content for brands with a combined 30,000+ followers and an algorithm that's currently on fire. You will be making a real impact. The deal: - $10 USD/hour via Hubstaff, growing as the role grows - Paid every 2 weeks via Wise, on time - Pro-rated 13th month bonus every December - Long-term role with growing hours and responsibilities - Paid 2-week trial period before formal long-term hiring The role starts at 10 hrs/week. She started at 30 minutes a week and now works 20-30 hours a week with multiple raises along the way. When I say long-term and growing, I mean it. Schedule: Flexible on when you work. What matters is the posting calendar: videos edited, scheduled, and live on time, every day. ~80% short-form content, ~10% long-form content, ~10% scheduling said content To be clear: short-form IS this role. If you're elite at short-form and just decent at long-form, you're exactly who I'm looking for. If long-form explainers are your specialty, this isn't your job. What you'll do: - Edit short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) for my brands: hooks, captions, pacing, sound - Main work entails working with AI-generated video clips (Higgsfield) and making viral short-form content: assembling, polishing, and making them feel native to the platform - Schedule and publish all content via Metricool across multiple accounts - Follow and improve our content SOPs (hook formulas, caption styles, what's working) - Secondary task: edit my personal channel. 5-10 minute talking-head videos plus shorts, 1-2 per week, simple clean style - Communicate with me daily via WhatsApp (async, I don't expect instant replies) - Take on new responsibilities as the business grows Hard skills required (short-form specific): - Elite short-form editing in CapCut: hooks that stop the scroll in under 1 second, pacing that holds retention, captions and sound that feel native to the platform - You can look at a video's first 3 seconds and tell me why it will or won't get pushed by the algorithm - A track record editing for TikTok/Reels/Shorts specifically. Show me, don't tell me. - You watch short-form daily and know the difference between an amazing video, a good one, and a bad one - Comfortable with Metricool (or willing to learn quickly) - Good written English, reliable internet, and a machine that can handle editing Soft skills required: - Highly coachable: I'll teach you our brand styles, hook formulas, and workflows. Learn fast and ask good questions. - Detail-oriented: a typo in a caption or a video posted to the wrong account costs real money - Consistent: this role lives and dies on the posting schedule - Has taste: you should have opinions about why a video is boring and how to fix it How to apply: No skills test, no essay. Just message me the link to one Loom video, covering these things. 5 minutes max or you will be disqualified. Being concise is crucial in this role, refilm if needed: - About yourself. Your short-form editing experience and why you fit this role - One thing that actually makes you you (a weird hobby, a strong opinion, your worst cooking disaster, anything but "I'm passionate about editing") - Screen-share 1-2 short-form videos you've edited that performed well (TikTok/Reels/Shorts, NOT long-form explainers, those will be ignored) and walk me through: why that hook, why that cut, what you'd change now. Show me the timeline. If you've run accounts with big view counts, drop those links too. - Please attach your portfolio via Google Drive if you have it. If not OK. Loom is the most important part. One real ask: don't run this through ChatGPT and read it off a script. I can tell instantly, it's painfully obvious, and it looks exactly like every other application. I'd genuinely rather watch you fumble through a real answer than nail a robotic one. Be a person, get creative, go off-script. There are no rules here, I just want it from the heart. I will watch every single Loom. Impress me, be different, and be creative!

Required Skills --------------------- - Strong Figma skills - Website design experience - Ability to create new website sections, not just edit existing designs - Good understanding of layout, spacing, hierarchy, and visual polish - Ability to create early look-and-feel concepts - Ability to understand client brands - Ability to analyse competitor websites - Ability to understand customer needs and website goals - Clear written English for internal notes and design rationale - Good communication in Slack and Google Docs - Comfortable using ClickUp for task updates and time tracking - Comfortable using ChatGPT as a thinking and research support tool English Requirement ----------------------------- You do not need to be a copywriter or client presenter. You must not work with other clients while engaged in this role - Daily time tracking is required in ClickUp - No screenshots or activity monitoring required - Confidentiality and IP ownership agreement required Access and Confidentiality ------------------------------------ You will have access to internal documentation, project files, client information, Figma files, brand assets, and other materials required to do the role well. All work created during the role, including strategy notes, design concepts, Figma files, website layouts, written documentation, research outputs, and related assets, will be owned by the company. You may not share client work publicly, use it in a portfolio, or reuse it elsewhere without written approval. Who This Role Is Not For --------------------------------- Please do not apply if: - You only want to follow the exact design instructions - You are not comfortable thinking strategically - You cannot explain your design decisions - You do not like researching competitors or industries - You only want production design tasks - You cannot work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST - You are currently working with other clients and want to keep doing so - You are not comfortable with ClickUp time tracking How To Apply -------------------- Submit your application to ---------- Please include the following in your application: 1. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native)
description: I'm Connor, founder of AdStream. I'm based in Australia and I run this company small and fast. AdStream manages the ad creative workflow for e-commerce brands running creator-made (UGC) video ads at volume: creative briefs go out, creators upload video, the brand's team reviews and approves everything in the browser, and approved ads publish straight to Meta. See it for yourself before you apply. Make an account at ---------- , click around, poke at the brief and review flows. The best applications come from people who've actually touched the product. What we're building right now Video playback. Reviewers play and scrub large creator videos in the browser, and right now playback is laggy. We serve full-quality source files straight from S3, so reviewers wait on buffering instead of reviewing. The route forward is Drive-first: Google Drive becomes the home for every customer asset. That gets us three things at once, fast playback on large files, customer assets living in their own Google Drive (a place they control and a brand they already trust), and the foundation for semantic search. That last one is the exciting part: once every file lands in Drive, we process it, get the transcript and text embeddings so you can search what's said in a video, frame embeddings so you can search what's visually in it. "Find b-roll with a kettle on a table." "Pull every clip where someone says sustainable." Internal teams find images, b-roll and past ads in seconds instead of scrubbing through folders, which makes video editing and graphic design dramatically faster. Beyond that, the roadmap you'd own: deepening the Meta integration and adding TikTok (OAuth, campaign publishing, status webhooks), AI creative generation with OpenAI, and Stripe billing. The stack Next.js 15 (App Router, server actions) + React 19 + TypeScript. Tailwind v4. Supabase — Postgres with row-level security, auth, storage. AWS S3. Google Drive API. Meta Graph API. OpenAI. Deployed on Vercel. You don't need prior experience with every line, but be honest about which parts you haven't touched, and don't propose a rewrite in week two. This is an AI-native role We provide a paid Claude Code seat and cover your AI tooling. You must already work this way daily, agentic tools (Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent), not autocomplete. You can write a spec an agent can execute, review agent output critically instead of trusting it, and verify AI-written code before it ships. One senior with a real agentic workflow now ships what a small team shipped a few years ago, that's the bet this role is built on. How we work: A 10–20 minute call every morning: what's planned today, review of yesterday, check in on deadlines. We agree on milestones upfront so everyone stays accountable. Be upfront about how long things will take. Not so we can micromanage, so we can be honest with our users and set expectations they can trust. Don't tell us it's a day if it's a week. Own outcomes, not tasks. Questions early, blockers immediately. Async outside the morning call: Looms, written updates. Hours are 9am–5pm AEST — a normal 7am–3pm day shift in the Philippines, evenings free. How to apply: Start your application with the exact phrase "Drive-first." It tells me you actually read this. Record a Loom (5 minutes max — clear and tight beats thorough and rambling) covering: You and your work. Quick intro, then walk me through something real you've shipped, what it does and what you built. AI doing meaningful work. One real example of using an agent for something substantial: how you directed it, something it got wrong that you caught, and how you verified it before shipping. I want to see judgment, not AI slop. How AI changed your workflow. How much more do you ship now? Do you still write most lines by hand, or mostly review and direct? Your models. Which model do you prefer and why? Do you run more than one, and how do you split work between them? If your Loom lands, we'll jump on a call. Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: TikTok Content Strategist — Part-Time, Philippines-Based
description: Is This You? You've owned a brand's TikTok presence — not just edited videos for one. You built the strategy, d ---------- what to post and why, watched the numbers, formed a hypothesis, and adjusted. You know what's converting this week. You know which sounds are peaking. You understand why one hook stops thumbs and another doesn't. Editing is a tool you use. It is not what you are. If you're primarily a video editor who also posts to TikTok, this role isn't for you. If you're a platform strategist who can also cut and edit, keep reading. What You'll Own • Strategy first. You'll d ---------- what content to make, why, and when — for 2–3 DTC product brands in the US natural goods space (bar soap, tallow skincare, freeze-dried pet treats). Footage comes from the brand owner and UGC creators. Your job is to turn that footage into a content strategy that drives real growth. • Build and own the content calendar. Hit deadlines without being reminded. • Write hooks that compete. Every video starts with a line or visual that earns the next three seconds. You'll be held to this. • Select audio with intent — trending sounds, original audio, voiceover decisions. You'll know why you chose what you chose. • Edit for performance: pacing, completion rate, CTA placement. CapCut or similar. Editing is a means to an end — the end is results. • Transform UGC and existing footage into original-feeling content. You know how to recut, reframe, and re-score so the algorithm treats it as new. Uncut re-uploads aren't in your vocabulary. • Use native TikTok formats — Duet, Stitch, Green Screen — as deliberate reach tools, not as features you stumbled across. • Repurpose top-performing TikToks for Instagram Reels. Manage Facebook pages as a secondary duty. • Monitor comments and DMs; flag anything needing owner attention. • Coordinate with TikTok Shop: product links, affiliate awareness, live selling when applicable. • Track your own metrics — watch time, saves, shares, follower growth — and deliver a clear weekly summary. Honest numbers, not vanity metrics. • Proactively bring ideas, trend observations, and competitive intel. Don't wait to be asked. What We're Looking For Hard Requirements • Minimum 2 years managing TikTok strategy and growth for a US-market brand or agency client — not just editing videos for one • Demonstrated results: account growth, engagement lifts, or performance data you can point to and explain • Fluent written English — you write scripts, captions, and communicate directly with the brand owner • Comfortable editing in CapCut or equivalent — editing is a required supporting skill, not the job itself • Async-friendly, reliable, deadline-driven — you treat a posting schedule like a commitment • Able to work with minimal supervision on a fully remote team Strong Advantages • TikTok Shop experience: product linking, affiliate coordination, LIVE commerce awareness • Proficiency with Duet, Stitch, and Green Screen as strategic reach tools • Experience in natural products, wellness, pet, or handcrafted goods categories • Familiarity with US DTC consumer behavior ?? TikTok Compliance & Platform Intelligence — Non-Negotiable These brands operate in regulated-adjacent categories: skincare, pet nutrition, personal care. One post with the wrong claim, a banned audio track, or an undetected policy violation can suppress an account, restrict a shop, or worse. This role requires someone who treats TikTok's Terms of Service, Community Guidelines, and Commerce Policies as required reading — not fine print. That means: • You track policy updates. You know what changed in the last 90 days and what it means for product content. • You flag risks before posting — not after. • You know what can and cannot appear in TikTok Shop listings, captions, and on-screen text for health and wellness products. • You understand duplicate content detection and how to re-edit UGC properly so it registers as original. • You can explain your compliance reasoning when asked. Candidates who treat this as a checkbox will not advance. Candidates who treat this as a professional discipline will. What You'll Get • $350–$550 USD/month, part-time (~20 hours/week) — based on experience and results. Clear path to full-time as the brands grow. • Fully remote, async-first. No micromanagement, no daily check-ins. Own your schedule as long as deadlines are met. • Stable, long-term engagement — not a project hire. The right person grows with us. • Clean scope. No customer service, no inventory, no tasks outside your lane. • Direct access to the brand owner — fast decisions, real feedback, good work recognized. How to Apply Send the following via onlinejobs.ph message: 1. A brief intro (3–5 sentences): who you are, what TikTok accounts or brands you've managed, and one result you drove that you're proud of. 2. Links to 2–3 TikTok accounts you've managed. If under NDA, describe the account — but be specific about what you did and what happened. 3. Your answer to this required question. No answer = no consideration: "Name one TikTok rule, policy change, or platform update from the last 6 months that could affect a US e-commerce brand selling physical products. How would you handle it — in your content approach and in what you'd communicate to the brand owner?" Answer in your own words. A vague or generic response tells us everything we need to know. These are small, real brands built around products people genuinely love. We're not filling a seat — we're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, wants a stable long-term role, and is ready to grow alongside us. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES • VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent. • DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA. • Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points. • Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals. • Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data. • Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and email funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement. • Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders. MUST-HAVES • Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes. • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines. • Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually. • Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats. • Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats). • Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism. • Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours. BONUS SKILLS • Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs. • Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics. • Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video). • Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow. • Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats. **Complex problem analysis** — dig into vague or multi-layered customer problems, ask the right questions, find the root cause, and translate it into clear, actionable tickets — you think along with the customer instead of just logging what they say - **Backlog hygiene & reporting** — periodic backlog clean-ups, sprint/cycle progress reports, flag bottlenecks and stale tickets - **Scrum collaboration** — participate in the daily scrum and sprint rituals with our (remote, English-speaking) dev team ### Requirements - 2+ years hands-on experience with **Jira and Jira Service Management** (workflows, boards, linking, JQL is a plus) - **Excellent written English** — you write user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer-facing updates - Extremely detail-oriented and process-driven — status accuracy and ticket quality are the core of this job - **High analytical intelligence (IQ 120+)** — you can break a complex, ambiguous problem down to its root cause and concrete next steps. We test cognitive ability as part of the hiring process. - Reliable availability with **overlap with European (CET) morning hours** — our response SLA is contractual - Experience working with Scrum/agile software teams - Comfortable working with AI-assisted tooling and structured runbooks (we document everything; you follow and improve the playbook) - Self-starter who escalates early instead of guessing ### Nice to have - Experience with manual QA / acceptance testing of web applications - Experience configuring SaaS platforms (workflows, templates, settings) - Experience at a SaaS / software product company - Confluence experience - Basic understanding of software release cycles (staging vs production) ### How to apply Reply with: 1. We are a Shark Tank-featured pet brand with customers around the world, and we believe every tag deserves care, accuracy, and a little SiliDog magic. Our tags stay with dogs for life. We want every customer to feel proud when their dog wears one. That means the details matter. We are looking for a part-time remote team member to help review, edit, and prepare personalized pet tag templates before they go to production. About the Role This is not a basic data entry job. This role combines proofreading, template editing, customer order review, layout checking, and production preparation. You will help make sure each customer’s tag is spelled correctly, formatted beautifully, and prepared according to SiliDog’s standards before it is sent to our production team. You will be working with customer-submitted personalization, so good judgment is important. Sometimes customers make typos. Sometimes they ask for something silly, unique, emotional, or unusual. Your job is to know when to correct something, when to preserve the customer’s personality, and when to ask for help. We call this adding SiliDog magic. Responsibilities Review personalized pet tag orders for spelling, capitalization, punctuation, formatting, and missing information Edit tag templates manually so the text is centered, balanced, properly sized, and production-ready Move text, resize names, adjust line breaks, and format information within SiliDog’s template guidelines Check tag shape, color, front/back personalization, order notes, and special customer requests Identify potential customer errors, such as missing phone number digits, unusual punctuation, unclear wording, or incomplete personalization Contact customers through Shopify when clarification is needed, following our SOP Contact a SiliDog team member when clarification is needed for vendor orders such as Chewy or PetSmart Save/export completed files in the proper SVG or EPS format Email completed templates to the production team Send the required screenshot or upload reference so the production team can load the templates properly Ask production questions when needed and learn from feedback Help improve the process as we continue building automation Tools Used Experience with all of these is not required, but comfort learning software is important. You may use: Adobe Illustrator Corel Shopify SiliDog’s custom internal app ShipStation WhatsApp Email Experience with Adobe Illustrator or similar design/template software is strongly preferred. Schedule This is a part-time remote position. Expected starting workload is approximately 5–6 hours per week, organized around daily production batches. Typical schedule: Monday: heavier batch day Tuesday–Friday: lighter daily batch work No regular weekend work expected unless discussed in advance Completed templates must be reviewed, batched, and sent to production by 9:30am Eastern Time each workday unless otherwise noted. Morning availability is important. Some vendor orders, especially from partners like Chewy, need to be included in the morning batch if they are received by 9:00am Eastern Time. Because of this, the ideal candidate should be available close to the morning deadline rather than only working overnight. There is potential for the hours to increase over the next 6 months. The right person may also have the opportunity to grow into related responsibilities if it is a good fit. Training We will provide training videos, examples, SOPs, and before/after template references so you can learn the SiliDog standard. You will be trained on: How to review customer personalization How to edit templates properly How to handle common exceptions How to save and upload files How to contact customers when clarification is needed How to send completed batches to production When to ask the SiliDog team for help Ideal Candidate You may be a great fit if you are: Extremely detail-oriented Strong with spelling, grammar, punctuation, and formatting Comfortable editing templates and visual layouts Experienced with Adobe Illustrator, Corel, Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools Reliable with daily deadlines Careful, patient, and consistent Good at noticing when something “looks off” Able to follow SOPs while also using common sense Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear Warm, positive, and excited to work with a fun pet brand Able to understand that every tag belongs to a real pet and customer Proofreading, journalism, copy editing, graphic design, production art, e-commerce, Shopify, or customer service experience is a plus. What Makes This Role Special Our customers are pet parents. Some are silly. Some are emotional. Some have very specific requests. Some make mistakes without realizing it. The right person will help us protect the customer experience while making sure production receives clean, accurate, beautiful templates. This is a small role, but it is an important one. To Apply Please send: A short introduction about yourself Your experience with proofreading, template editing, Adobe Illustrator, Corel, Shopify, or similar tools Your hourly rate Your availability Monday through Friday before 9:30am Eastern Time A quick explanation of how you would handle a customer order that looks like it may have a typo The word “Bentley” in your application so we know you read the full post We may ask shortlisted applicants to complete a short paid test using sample tag orders.

title: BodyCam Footage Researcher
description: We are a growing YouTube automation channel focused on official police body cam footage and true crime content. I am based in the USA and looking for a reliable long term FOIA researcher to work with me on an ongoing basis. Here is exactly what I need: - Raw official police body cam footage obtained through FOIA requests - Footage must be full length — minimum 20 to 30 minutes per incident ideally longer - Incidents should be high tension and engaging — traffic stops, arrests, pursuits, investigations and dramatic encounters - Footage must be from official public domain sources only and safe to use on YouTube without copyright issues - I need footage from specific trending incidents that I will choose based on what is making the news - I will need a consistent supply — ideally 3 to 5 footage files delivered per week Each footage must also come with a detailed incident report and/or news articles pertaining to the incident - Footage should be downloadable in original video format ready to send to my editor Price per incident is $15-20. If this is not acceptable, please do not submit a proposal ** I WILL PAY $20-25 PER INCIDENT IF THE INCIDENT INVOLVES FRAUD (IDENTITY FRAUD, FINANCIAL FRAUD, INSTITUTIONAL FRAUD, ETC) Prioritize footage from the last 1–3 years Familiarity with sources such as: - Local/state police department public release portals - YouTube law enforcement channels - Court TV, news broadcasts with body cam segments - FOIA request databases Strong eye for footage that is compelling, clear, and tells a story Consistent, reliable delivery — this is a weekly commitment Strong written English communication What We're NOT Looking For: - Footage older than 3 years unless exceptionally compelling - Clips that are blurred beyond usability or lacking audio Please include the following in your proposal: - Brief description of your research process and go-to sources for this type of content - 1-3 examples of body cam or law enforcement footage links you've previously sourced (portfolio/samples) Applications without samples will not be considered. This is an ongoing contract with the potential to grow into a broader research role as the channel scales.

title: Klaviyo Expert - Email Marketing Technician & Quality Assurance (E-Commerce)

description: Summary Klaviyo Expert who owns the technical execution and the final quality gate for retention marketing (email , WhatsApp, signup forms) across e-commerce client accounts in the DACH region. About us The Marketing Collective is a boutique done-for-you retention marketing agency for German-speaking e-commerce brands. We run Klaviyo email programs, WhatsApp campaigns (Chatarmin/Charles), and data-driven segmentation across multiple client accounts. Every brand is served by a three-person pod: the Brand Manager writes the copy, the Designer designs the email , and you execute, QA, and ship it in Klaviyo. You are the final gate before anything reaches a customer. When it works, no one thinks about it. When it breaks, everyone does. That is why diligence and a love for detail matter more in this role than anywhere else. What you'll do Execution (the majority of the work) - Set up campaigns in Klaviyo: segments and exclusions, UTM tracking, Smart Sending, promo code verification, campaign tagging - Run our full 18-item pre-send QA checklist (links, buttons, mobile, dark mode, dynamic variables, file size, segments, send time) and schedule the send - Build flows: triggers, flow and profile filters, conditional/trigger splits; QA with our checklist, set live, and review 24-48h after launch - Implement, QA, and schedule WhatsApp campaigns in Chatarmin/Charles - Own the technical setup and go-live of signup forms: end-to-end submission testing, GDPR/CAN-SPAM compliance (the Designer owns the visual build) - Set up A/B tests, check functionality, document results - Clone, QA, and schedule translated campaign versions - Light email design in Klaviyo with our modular templates when needed (you do not own design) Strategy and maintenance - Create flow briefings that fully inform the Brand Manager (copy) and Designer (visual direction) - Develop segmentation strategies along our frameworks (VIP, engagement, lifecycle, product affinity), e.g. for BFCM - Analyze performance in Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and BI tools; make data-driven recommendations - Weekly Klaviyo monitor checks and monthly health checks for every client: deliverability, list hygiene, suppression, integration errors Coordination - Daily ClickUp check-ins; Slack communication with the team and in client channels - Give the Designer feedback on asset quality; create and update SOPs The standard we hold - 100% pre-send QA completion: the checklist runs in full, every time, no exceptions - Zero critical QA misses per month (broken links, wrong promo codes, missing unsubscribe link, wrong segment, broken mobile rendering, blank dynamic variables) - 95%+ on-time sends - When a mistake happens, you own it, document the root cause, and facilitate a process update so it does not happen twice What you bring - 2-3+ years in digital marketing, ideally e-commerce - 1-2+ years hands-on Klaviyo: building flows, running campaigns, managing multiple accounts - Extreme attention to detail with excellent follow-through - the single most important trait for this role - Strong technical judgement in Klaviyo: flow logic, Smart Sending vs Smart Send Time, deliverability, segmentation - Comfortable working in German-language accounts and QA-ing translated copy against the copy doc (native German NOT required; we work with AI tools and client confirmation) - Well-versed in GDPR and CAN-SPAM - Proactive and self-managed: you run a portfolio of accounts with minimal supervision (you start at 2-3 accounts and ramp to 8-10) - Full-time availability (40 hrs/week) with working-hour overlap with European (CET) business hours Nice to have - Chatarmin/Charles, Shopify, Google Analytics - Figma or Canva for light email design - AI tools for QA, briefings, and translation - KnoCommerce, Decify, Typeform (surveys); Sendtric (countdown timers) Why work with us - Long-term role: our tea ---------- mbers have been with us for years - Clear growth path from technical execution to strategic ownership (segment definitions, flow logic, account-level calls) - Supportive remote team with clear systems and SOPs, experienced and empathetic leadership - No hustle culture: if you are good at your job, 8 hours a day, 5 days a week is enough to do exceptional work - and we hire ahead so it stays that way Project details - Contract: Full-time, long-term (40 hrs/week) - Experience level: Intermediate to Expert - Remote: Yes - Start: ASAP How to apply (required) Please include: - A brief summary of your Klaviyo experience: accounts you've managed, flows you've built, and the QA process you follow before a send - 2-3 examples of Klaviyo work you executed yourself (flows, campaigns, or signup forms; screenshots or links) - A short Loom video (2-3 minutes) on why you're a good fit for this specific role - Weekly availability and preferred working hours - Rate expectations - Bonus: name one thing you always check right before scheduling a campaign that most people forget (and to prove you read the whole thing).

title: Social Media Growth Manager

This role is for someone who understands what makes people stop, watch, and buy on social platforms—and can build a repeatable system to produce that content at scale. You'll create content that doesn't look like ads but drives measurable results: ROAS, conversions, and profitable growth. You will work with our video editor and designer to create these content. We Want Someone Who Can: - Create thumb-stopping social content that sells (not traditional ads) - Build systematic content production workflows - Think in pipelines: ideation ? scripting ? production ? testing ? scaling - Learn Meta ads strategy and apply creative thinking to performance marketing - Analyse what works and turn wins into repeatable systems You Will Manage: - Content ideation and scripting - Creator briefing and coordination - Production workflows and quality control - Creative testing frameworks - Performance analysis (with our guidance on media buying) Who This Role is NOT For: - people who are not interested in numbers, testing and optimization - people who only want to make aesthetic content without thinking of conversion - people who never scripted or produced video content at scale Who this role is for: You'll thrive here if: - You have taste. Responsibilities: - Content Production System: Build a pipeline that delivers 5-10 weekly video creatives that feel native to social platforms but drive conversions. - End-to-End Script Development: Write scroll-stopping scripts based on customer pain points, brand voice, and platform best practices. Develop creative briefs for execution. - Creator Management: Coordinate creators in the US and Australia with precise briefs, manage timelines, ensure quality control, and build templates for consistent output. - Systematic Testing Framework: Launch structured creative tests to test how the content convert - scale winners, kill losers fast. - Performance Analysis: Monitor daily creative performance (we'll teach you the metrics), conduct weekly refreshes to combat fatigue, deliver monthly reports, and refine the system. - Learn & Scale: Work closely with the CEO to learn Meta ads strategy, apply your creative thinking to media buying, and take increasing ownership of budget and ROAS targets over time. What We're Looking For: - 3+ years creating social content that drove measurable results (sales, leads, or high engagement) - Portfolio of 30+ short-form videos you've scripted or produced - Proven ability to build workflows and manage production pipelines - Strong writing skills for scripts, hooks, and direct-response copy - Willingness to learn performance marketing and data analysis - Experience managing creators or production workflows (preferred but not required) Details: - Location: Remote (Philippines-based) - Remuneration: 80, ---------- ,000 PHP/month (based on experience) - Commitment: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 9.30am - 6.30pm (GMT+8) Why Join Crafti? - Work on Products That Sell Themselves: Our wellness and lifestyle products are genuinely exciting to market. You'll create content for products that improve people's lives, with authentic customer stories that make compelling material. - Direct Impact & CEO Access: You'll report directly to the CEO with full ownership of our content-to-conversion system. Your creatives directly drive revenue—when you win, the company wins. - Rapid Career Growth: We're scaling from 7 to 8 figures, and you'll grow with us. Strong performers can progress from Content Lead to Head of Growth within 12-18 months. About Crafti Crafti is a fast-growing Direct-to-Consumer health and wellness brand with sales in the USA and Singapore. We are headquartered in Singapore and operate remotely across 4 countries. In the last 4 years, we've grown to 7 figures in annual revenue with 60–80% YoY growth. As we scale towards 8 figures, we're looking for driven individuals who want to learn, grow, and advance quickly alongside the company.

Important Notes for Applicants A few things to be aware of before applying: This business operates across multiple entities (residential, remedial, and government), each with separate Xero tracking codes and, in some cases, separate bank accounts. title: Full-Time Graphic Designer & Social Video Content Creator
job_title: Full-Time Graphic Designer & Social Video Content Creator
description: About Us Reputation Elevation provides a full suite of digital marketing services, with a special focus on the autism therapy (ABA) space. Innovation, exceptional client service, and real results are at our core. Our design team produces a high volume of paid-social and Google ad creative — fast, on-brand, and built to perform. The Role We’re hiring a full-time Graphic Designer and Social Media Video Creator with genuine taste and creative instinct. You have a sharp eye for design, you can write a headline that stops the scroll, and you can turn a brief into polished image and video ads quickly. You’ll work closely with our ads team to concept and produce creative that wins attention and drives leads. This is a high-output, direct-response role. You’ll often work within strict brand and content constraints (more on that below) and still find a way to make the work feel fresh. If you love the craft of making one ad clearly outperform another, you’ll fit in here. Creativity is only half the job. The other half is execution: being quick, organized, and meticulous. A typical assignment is a set of graphics and short videos due in 3 business days — and “due in 3 business days” means done in 3 business days. Many clients run campaigns in multiple cities, so you’ll often produce near-identical creative sets that differ only in the details — the Atlanta set says Atlanta, the Savannah set says Savannah, and every location-specific element is right in each one. If that level of precision sounds tedious, this isn’t the role; if it sounds obvious, read on. What You’ll Do • Concept and produce high-quality image and video ads for Facebook /Instagram and Google. • Write short, punchy on-asset copy and headlines — not just lay out design. • Tailor creative to ABA therapy providers and our other client industries. • Localize creative sets for multi-market clients — same campaign, different city — getting every location-specific detail right on every version. • Use generative AI as a core part of your workflow to move fast without sacrificing taste. • Partner with the ads team to understand each client and ship creative that hits the campaign goal. • Turn work around on schedule — a standard set of graphics and short videos is assigned with a 3-business-day deadline, and it ships on time, every time. • Deliver organized, editable source files for everything you make. • Keep current on what’s working in paid-social creative and bring ideas to the table. Tools You’ll Use We care about output and taste more than any specific software, but you should be fluent across these categories: • Canva — core to our workflow; you should be very comfortable here. • AI video generation — comfort with current AI video tools for generating and animating ad footage. • Image editing — a professional editor such as Photoshop (or equivalent). • AI image generation — generating and refining on-brand still imagery. • Video editing — assembling short-form video with text, captions, and music. How We Work • Schedule — Full-time. You set your own hours, but you must be reliably available for live overlap from 3:00–6:00 PM Israel time for calls and feedback. • Deadlines — A typical assignment is a set of graphics and short videos with a 3-business-day turnaround. Deadlines are firm; if something threatens one, you flag it early, not on the due date. • Project management — Assignments are managed in ClickUp. • File handling — All work, including editable source files, is uploaded to our shared Google Drive. • Ad accounts — You may be added to our clients’ Facebook Ads accounts to upload creative. Content Standards (Please Read) Our ABA therapy clients require brand-safe, conservative creative. The first rule applies to every asset; the depiction rules apply whenever people appear: • The word “autism” or “ABA therapy” must be clearly visible in the text of every ad. • When people are shown, they’re conservatively dressed — elbows, knees, and collarbones covered — with conservative hairstyles. • Any children depicted read as ordinary, neurotypical kids. • When therapists are shown, they wear casual professional clothing — no lab coats or scrubs. If tightly constrained creative frustrates you, this likely isn’t the right role. If you see constraints as a fun problem to solve, you’ll thrive. We only view job applications from people who really read this through. Prove you read this by including the word “elephant” in your application message. Creative Range (Also Please Read) The rules above govern what appears on an asset — they do not mean every ad shows a therapy session, a child, or even a person. Many of our best-performing creatives don’t. Styles in our rotation include: • Text-only — typographic ads where the headline is the design. • Mood-setting — e.g., aerial footage of a beautiful landscape with a line about autism or ABA written over it. • Animated — animation works when it’s tasteful; it must never read as anime or feel immature. • UGC-style — an image or video of a parent at home, or a therapist working while a parent watches, with text on top. Feels authentic rather than produced. That list isn’t a menu to pick from — it’s a starting point. There are endless creative styles to innovate, and part of this job is bringing us formats we haven’t tried. We want someone who works within our rules and keeps pushing the style range. job_title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper — Multi-Entity (QuickBooks Online + Tekmetric) | US Auto Repair Group
description: We're a US-based holding company that owns and operates a growing group of independent automotive repair shops across Texas. We acquire shops and bring them onto a shared accounting platform, so the books span multiple legal entities (operating companies, a holding company, and property-holding entities) with transactions flowing between them. You'll own the day-to-day and month-end books across all entities in QuickBooks Online. A US CPA reviews and files; your job is to deliver clean, reconciled, close-ready books and supporting schedules every month so that review is fast and the filings are accurate. This is a finance-operations role, not data entry. As we close new acquisitions, you'll onboard each new shop into the books — so the role grows with the portfolio. What you'll own - Multi-entity bookkeeping in QBO — maintain accurate books across the holding company, multiple operating shops, and property entities. - Accounts payable — enter and code vendor bills (including auto parts and tire suppliers), manage the AP schedule, prep payment runs for approval. - Accounts receivable — record customer invoicing where applicable and follow up on open balances. - Payroll — record and reconcile payroll across entities. - Reconciliations — monthly bank and credit-card reconciliations for every entity, plus loan and liability accounts. - Parts cost reconciliation — match parts purchases and repair orders from our shop-management system (Tekmetric) against QuickBooks using a reconciliation tool (WickedFile); investigate and flag variances between what was bought, what was billed, and what was booked. - Intercompany — track and keep clean the transactions between entities (rent between property and operating companies, management fees from the holding company, owner draws/loans). - Month-end close — accruals, prepaids, reconciliations, and supporting schedules; deliver close-ready books to our CPA for review and filing. - Reporting — monthly P&L and balance sheet by entity plus a consolidated view; proactively flag anomalies, margin movements, and anything that looks off. - New-shop onboarding — when we acquire a shop, set up or clean its chart of accounts, load opening balances, and standardize it onto our platform. - Documentation & support — maintain a clean audit trail and support diligence, lender/SBA reporting, and annual tax prep. Requirements - 5+ years of full-charge bookkeeping for US-based clients (multi-entity experience strongly preferred). - Expert in QuickBooks Online — you'll be asked to complete a short QBO test. - Comfortable working on the accrual basis and running a month-end close. - Strong reconciliation discipline and obsessive accuracy — you catch the small stuff before it compounds. - Clear written English and proactive communication — you flag issues early instead of sitting on them. - Reliable computer (i5 or better, 8GB+ RAM) and internet ? 50 Mbps; able to work the overlap window above. - Looking for a long-term, full-time, single-client commitment. Bonus (not required, but moves you to the top of the pile) - QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification. - Experience with auto repair, multi-location retail, or field-service businesses. - Familiarity with a shop-management system (Tekmetric, Shopmonkey, Mitchell, etc.) and/or a parts/spend reconciliation tool (WickedFile, Ramp). - Experience supporting a US CPA through close and tax filing. - Experience onboarding newly acquired entities (roll-up / M&A bookkeeping). Why this role You'll be the financial backbone of a fast-growing operator, with real ownership and visibility into how acquisitions are run. As the portfolio grows, there's room to take on more responsibility and eventually help build out a small finance team. We pay above the local market for the right person and reward people who take ownership.

title: CONSTRUCTION REDLINE DATA-ENTRY SPECIALIST (PART-TIME)
description: Remote, Philippines | Part-time, long-term | US Evening hours BEFORE YOU APPLY: Read this entire post. The first line of your application MUST start with the phrase "REDLINE-READY" followed by your favorite two-digit number (for example, "REDLINE-READY 27"). Applications that skip this step are auto-rejected without review. ABOUT THE ROLE We are a U.S. underground fiber-optic construction company. Every evening our field crews (called "foremen") finish their digging and send in "redline" reports. These are marked-up screenshots of engineering prints where the crew highlights the section of pipe they installed that day and writes the footage by hand. Your job is to turn those daily screenshots into clean records: read the footage and location off each redline, transcribe it onto the master project PDF, double-check that everything reads correctly, and log it in our Excel tracker by foreman, work type, and footage. Accuracy matters, because these numbers feed our weekly billing. This is a recurring daily task (about 1 to 2 hours per evening). It is the first thing we want off our plate, and there is room to grow into more work for the right person. WHAT YOU WILL DO EACH DAY - Collect the day's redline screenshots from each foreman (they arrive around 8:00 PM US time). - Read each redline: identify the highlighted (bored) section, read the handwritten footage number, and identify which print section or tag it belongs to. - Transcribe those footage amounts onto the master "After" PDF for the job. - Double-check your reading against the print to catch mis-reads or numbers that do not line up. - Log each entry in our Excel workbook: one row per entry (Date, Foreman, Work Type which is Bore or Structure, Footage, Notes). - Flag anything unclear or inconsistent instead of guessing. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR (MUST-HAVES) - Strong Excel skills. You are comfortable with data entry, SUMIFS/SUMIF, filtering, and spotting when a total does not match. - Ability to read technical prints or drawings. You can look at a map-style engineering print and figure out which section a marked-up area refers to. - Good written and spoken English. You can read instructions, ask clear questions, and explain what you see. - Strong attention to detail and problem-solving. You notice when numbers do not add up and you investigate rather than guess. - Reliable evening availability and a stable internet connection. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with construction, telecom, fiber/FTTX, utilities, GIS, or CAD/as-built drawings. - Experience as a virtual assistant doing data entry or document QC. - Familiarity with Adobe Acrobat annotation tools SCHEDULE AND PAY - Type: Part-time, ongoing (long-term). - Hours: About 1 to 2 hours per evening, starting after redlines arrive (around 8:00 PM US time). Roughly 5 days per week. - Pay: $3 to $5 per hour depending on experience, with a paid trial period and raises as you take on more. - Growth: Additional tasks and more hours available for a reliable, accurate performer. HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY) We use a simple multi-step filter so we only spend time on serious, capable applicants. Complete ALL four steps. Incomplete applications are not reviewed. 1. Passphrase. Start your message with "REDLINE-READY" plus your favorite two-digit number. 2. Screening questions. Answer the questions below briefly and honestly. 3. Skill check. Reply that you are willing to complete a short (about 20 to 30 minute) paid skill test where you read a few sample redlines and do a small Excel task. We send it to shortlisted applicants. 4. Short video. Record a 2 to 3 minute video (Loom or Google Drive link) speaking in English. Introduce yourself, describe your Excel experience, and explain in your own words how you would read a marked-up construction print to find the footage. We want to hear your English and your thinking. It does not need to be polished. SCREENING QUESTIONS (answer in your application) 1. On a scale of 1 to 10, how strong are your Excel skills, and what is the most advanced thing you have built or done in Excel? 2. Have you ever read technical drawings, blueprints, maps, or engineering prints? Describe where and how. 3. You read a redline and the handwritten footage looks like it could be "730" or "780." What do you do? 4. What are your typical available hours in US Eastern or Central time? 5. Confirm your internet speed and that you have a reliable computer. We reply to every complete, genuine application. Thank you for taking the time. We are looking for a long-term teammate, not just a quick gig.

Real estate finance vocabulary is required for this role — you'll be in DMs with investors using terms like BRRRR, sub2, DSCR, double close, EMD, gator, wholesale, and bridge daily. This is a real, ongoing role with documented systems already in place — full playbook, scripts, tracker, and KPI dashboard are ready on Day 1. The Two Products You'll Be Working 1. Hard Money Loans (Fix-and-Flip, Bridge, Ground-Up Construction, DSCR) — for active real estate investors with deals in pipeline needing rehab / bridge / construction / DSCR financing, residential or commercial. Application: ---------- /apply (with Andrea's referral link) 2. EMD / Double Close / Seller-Financed Down Payments — for investors needing short-term capital to cover earnest money or close creative finance deals (sub2, wholesale assignments). Application: ---------- (with Andrea's referral link) Your weekly target: 10–20 form fills split across the two products (target: ~7–14 Hard Money + ~3–6 EMD). What You'll Do - Source qualified prospects from real estate investor communities — Pace Morby's Sub2 Owners Club, AstroFlipping wholesaling groups, BiggerPockets investor forums, ---------- metro Facebook groups (DFW, Carolinas, others), LinkedIn REI creators, Instagram REI niche accounts - Run engagement-first outreach— comment thoughtfully in REI communities (deal-share posts, funding questions, creative finance threads), then DM the people who engage back - Route prospects to the correct product — investors needing rehab / flip / ground up construction / bridge / DSCR funding go to Hard Money; investors needing fast EMD or double-close capital go to EMD - Use pre-approved scripts and compliance language — never quote rates, never promise loan terms, never guarantee approval - Light qualifying only— what deal are they working on? What stage? — then send the appropriate intake form - Log every prospect in our Excel-based tracker with the correct Product tag - Hit 40–50 outreach touches per day across 4 hour workday - Run a weekly review call (Fridays) with the owner You're a Great Fit If - You've done outbound appointment setting before (sales VA, business development) and can show numbers from past roles - You're a near-native English speaker — REI prospects are unforgiving on VA-voiced DMs - You have real estate finance literacy— you understand or can quickly learn what hard money is, what an EMD is, what BRRRR / sub2 / DSCR / double close / wholesale assignment mean. Past experience working with US real estate brokers, lenders, or wholesalers is a strong plus. - You're disciplined about daily volume and tracking - You can stay strictly on-script around lending claims— no quoted rates, no promised approval - You're comfortable with LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, Gmail, Go High Level and Excel - You can work Mon–Fri during US Central Time business hours You're NOT a Fit If - Real estate finance vocabulary feels overwhelming or boring to you - You want to "improvise" the scripts — sorry, compliance is non-negotiable - You can't commit to consistent daily volume - You don't have outbound sales / appointment-setting experience - You can only work very late or very early relative to Central US time Logistics - Hours: 20 hours/week (4 hours/day, Mon–Fri), during US Central Time business hours - Pay: $2.50 - 5/hour - Start: ASAP — paid 1-week trial period - Tools: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, Gmail, Excel, Go High Level and our internal tracker - Training: Full onboarding curriculum provided — Day 1 is compliance + product overview + real estate finance vocabulary deep-dive - Long-term upside: After 60 days of consistent performance, we'll discuss either a rate increase or moving to a performance-bonus structure How to Apply - Please read carefully. 1. Include the phrase "PURPLE GIRAFFE" at the very top of your application. If it's not there, I will not read further. 2. Answer the screening questions below thoughtfully — not in one-sentence answers. 3. Record a 60-second Loom video introducing yourself in English. Tell me (a) why this real estate finance role interests you specifically and (b) one example of appointment-setting success from your past work, with numbers. Paste the Loom link in your application. Screening Questions 1. Compliance & Language Rewrite "Below is a sample message draft: 'Hi [name] — we can get you approved for a hard money loan at 7% with no money down, guaranteed funding in 5 days.' What is wrong with this message from a compliance standpoint, and how would you rewrite it to be safer while still being effective?" 2. Real Estate Finance Vocabulary Check "Briefly explain in your own words what each of these terms means: (a) Hard money loan, (b) Earnest money deposit (EMD), (c) DSCR loan, (d) BRRRR, (e) Sub2 / Subject-to, (f) Double close. We're not looking for textbook definitions — we want to see you understand the concepts well enough to talk to real estate investors about them." 3. Product Routing (Hard Money vs. EMD) "A real estate investor DMs you and says: 'I have a property under contract in Dallas. I'm doing a sub2 deal but the seller wants $30K earnest money in 5 days or they're walking. Need help fast.' Which of our two products is the right fit, and write the response you'd send them." 4. Public Group Engagement (No Pitching) "Imagine you see a post in a real estate investor Facebook group where someone writes: 'Looking for capital for a fix-and-flip in Phoenix. Any creative ideas?' — Write the comment you would leave on that PUBLIC post. The comment should NOT pitch our service directly." 5. The Warm DM (Hard Money) "Following your comment in Question 4, the person engages with you. Now write the DM you would send them to start a conversation about hard money options for their flip." 6. Handling a Tricky Inbound "A real estate investor replies to your DM and says: 'What's your interest rate and how fast can you close? I'll only fill out a form if I know the numbers.' — Write the response you'd send." 7. Daily Discipline "This role requires ~50–60 outreach touches per day, Mon–Fri, in real estate investor communities. Walk me through what a productive day looks like for you — including how you stay focused, how you avoid getting sloppy as fatigue sets in, and what your end-of-day routine looks like." 8. Track Record with Numbers "What outreach tools have you used (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, PhantomBuster, GHL, etc.)? Share one specific example where your outreach work generated booked appointments — include real numbers (touches ? replies ? booked). Real estate or lending experience preferred. If you don't have numbers, explain why." 9. Real Estate Community Experience "Are you currently active in (or have you worked with clients active in) any of these communities: Pace Morby's Sub2 / Gator Method group, AstroFlipping, BiggerPockets, ---------- Facebook groups, or any US real estate investor community? If yes, describe your experience. If no, are you willing to spend time learning these communities before Day 1?" 10. Time Zone Reality Check "This role works best Mon–Fri during US Central Time business hours (roughly 8am–5pm CT, with flexibility). What is your local time zone, and what specific hours would you commit to each weekday in YOUR local time? Be precise." 11. Past Boss / References "Provide the names and contact info (email or LinkedIn URL) of two former clients or managers who can speak to your appointment-setting work. We may reach out before extending an offer."
